quickReference.exampleEn: I'm looking for something light to read.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我想找点轻松的读物。

quickReference.note: 可说 recommend a book 或 recommend something to me；不要机械套所有中文“推荐给”。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you recommend a short novel?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能推荐一本短篇幅的小说吗？

quickReference.note: 通常不可数；具体一本小说可说 a novel。
quickReference.exampleEn: Where is the fiction section?
quickReference.exampleZh: 小说区在哪里？

quickReference.note: paperback 是平装本，hardback 或 hardcover 是精装本；edition 是版本或版次。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a paperback edition?
quickReference.exampleZh: 有平装版吗？

quickReference.note: in stock 指库存可买；on the shelf 指摆在货架上的位置。
quickReference.exampleEn: Do you have this title in stock?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这本书有现货吗？

quickReference.note: I am just browsing 可礼貌说明暂不需要推荐，不必承诺购买。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'm just browsing, thanks.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我先随便看看，谢谢。

chapters.title: 约朋友和自然接话
chapters.task: 邀约 · 改期 · 礼貌拒绝
chapters.example: Could we make it a bit later?
chapters.translation: 我们能约晚一点吗？
chapters.scenario: 约朋友周五吃饭。原定六点，但你下班后需要休息，想改到七点；另练习朋友临时取消和自己礼貌拒绝邀请。
phrases: be up for it 愿意参与
make it later 改晚一点
come up 临时出现
take a rain check 改天再约
catch up 叙旧或交流近况
head off 离开

lines.en: Could we make it a bit later?
lines.zh: 我们能约晚一点吗？

lines.en: Are you free on Friday evening?
lines.zh: 你周五晚上有空吗？

lines.en: Would you be up for dinner?
lines.zh: 你愿意一起吃晚饭吗？
lines.note: be up for 常用于较随意的邀约；正式商务邀请可以直接用 Would you like to...?

lines.en: That sounds good to me.
lines.zh: 我觉得不错。

lines.en: How about seven instead of six?
lines.zh: 改成七点，不约六点，怎么样？

lines.en: I'm pretty tired after work.
lines.zh: 我下班后挺累的。

lines.en: Something has come up.
lines.zh: 临时有点事。
lines.note: come up 表示出现了新情况；取消约定时还应明确说自己不能参加。

lines.en: No worries. We can do another day.
lines.zh: 没关系，可以改天。

lines.en: Thanks for asking, but I need a quiet evening.
lines.zh: 谢谢你邀请，不过我今晚想安静休息一下。

lines.en: Could I take a rain check?
lines.zh: 可以改天再约吗？
lines.note: 表达希望改天参与；若不想再约，直接感谢并婉拒更清楚。

lines.en: It was good catching up.
lines.zh: 能聊聊近况真不错。

lines.en: I'd better head off. See you soon.
lines.zh: 我该走了，回头见。

dialogues.title: 约饭并改时间
dialogues.subtitle: 给出原因和具体替代

lines.en: Are you free on Friday evening? Would you be up for dinner?
lines.zh: 周五晚上有空吗，要一起吃晚饭吗？

lines.en: Yes. How about six?
lines.zh: 有，六点怎么样？

lines.en: Could we make it a bit later? I'm pretty tired after work.
lines.zh: 能约晚一点吗，我下班后挺累的。

lines.en: Sure. Would seven work?
lines.zh: 可以，七点行吗？

lines.en: Seven is perfect. The place near the station?
lines.zh: 七点正好，车站附近那家吗？

lines.en: Yes. I'll meet you at the entrance.
lines.zh: 对，我在门口等你。

dialogues.title: 见面后自然收尾
dialogues.subtitle: 表达愉快并结束聊天

lines.en: How has your week been?
lines.zh: 这周过得怎么样？

lines.en: Busy, but good. It was nice to have a break tonight.
lines.zh: 忙，但还不错，今晚休息一下挺好的。

lines.en: Same here. We should do this again.
lines.zh: 我也是，下次再约吧。

lines.en: Definitely. I'd better head off now, though.
lines.zh: 好啊，不过我现在该走了。

lines.en: Of course. Get home safely.
lines.zh: 好，回家路上注意安全。

lines.en: Thanks. It was good catching up. See you soon.
lines.zh: 谢谢，聊聊近况真不错，回头见。

branches.title: 朋友临时取消
branches.subtitle: 接住对方说明再确认后续

lines.en: Sorry, something has come up. I can't make dinner tonight.
lines.zh: 抱歉，临时有事，今晚不能来吃饭了。

lines.en: No worries. Would you like to do another day?
lines.zh: 没关系，你想改天吗？

lines.en: Yes. Could we try next Tuesday?
lines.zh: 想，下周二可以吗？

lines.en: Tuesday works for me. We can confirm the time later.
lines.zh: 周二我可以，时间晚点再确认。

branches.title: 自己想婉拒
branches.subtitle: 清楚拒绝而不编理由

lines.en: Do you want to come out tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚想出来玩吗？

lines.en: Thanks for asking, but I need a quiet evening.
lines.zh: 谢谢邀请，不过今晚我想安静休息。

lines.en: No problem. Another time?
lines.zh: 没问题，改天？

lines.en: Yes, I'd like that. Let's talk next week.
lines.zh: 好啊，我愿意，下周再商量。

substitutions: 把 Friday evening 换成 Sunday afternoon，调整邀约。
把 seven instead of six 换成 eight instead of seven，给出明确改期。
把 dinner 换成 a walk，提议散步。
responses: Something has come up.
表示理解并提议改天。
No worries. We can do another day.
Would seven work?
答应并确认地点。
Yes. Shall we meet at the entrance?
Do you want to come out tonight?
谢邀但想休息。
Thanks for asking, but I need a quiet evening.
practice.task: 邀请朋友见面，协商时间地点；对方取消时自然接话，自己不想去时清楚婉拒。

quickReference.note: Would you be up for ...? 是轻松邀请；后面接活动或名词，不是问是否起床。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you be up for dinner?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你愿意一起吃晚饭吗？

quickReference.note: make it 在约时间语境中是定在某个时间，不是制作某件物品。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could we make it a bit later?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我们能约晚一点吗？

quickReference.note: 与朋友 catch up 不等于赶上交通工具；交通用 catch the train 等。
quickReference.exampleEn: It was good catching up.
quickReference.exampleZh: 能聊聊近况真不错。

quickReference.note: take a rain check 常用于这次去不了、希望改天；不是天气检查。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could I take a rain check?
quickReference.exampleZh: 可以改天再约吗？

quickReference.note: 表达自己的状态即可，不必总用夸张说法；可补 after work 说明原因。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'm pretty tired after work.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我下班后挺累的。

quickReference.note: Something has come up 用于有事临时发生；需要改期时再给一个替代安排。
quickReference.exampleEn: Something has come up.
quickReference.exampleZh: 临时有点事。

chapters.title: 理发与说明发型
chapters.task: 预约 · 说明长度 · 确认调整
chapters.example: I'd like a trim, please.
chapters.translation: 我想稍微修剪一下。
chapters.scenario: 你想预约周六下午三点理发，保留现有发型，只修短两侧和发尾。剪之前说清长度，剪完再检查；理发师的报价只代表这家练习中的店。
phrases: book a haircut 预约理发
a trim 稍作修剪
take a little off 稍微剪掉一点
keep the length 保留长度
tidy up the sideburns 修整鬓角
a wash and blow-dry 洗发和吹整

lines.en: I'd like a trim, please.
lines.zh: 我想稍微修剪一下。
lines.note: trim 通常指修掉少量头发、整理现有发型；想改变造型时还要说明具体要求。

lines.en: Do you have any appointments available on Saturday afternoon?
lines.zh: 周六下午还有可以预约的时间吗？

lines.en: We have a slot at three.
lines.zh: 我们三点有一个空档。

lines.en: I'd like a trim on the sides, but please keep the shape as it is.
lines.zh: 我想把两侧稍微修一下，但请保留现在的形状。

lines.en: Please keep the length on top.
lines.zh: 请保留头顶的长度。

lines.en: Could you take about a centimeter off?
lines.zh: 能剪掉大约一厘米吗？
lines.note: take ... off 在理发语境里指剪掉多少；最好用手势或照片确认，不只说 short。

lines.en: I'd like my fringe just above my eyebrows.
lines.zh: 我想让刘海刚好在眉毛上方。
lines.note: fringe 常用于英式英语；美式常说 bangs，例如 my bangs。

lines.en: Not too much off the sideburns. Just tidy them up, please.
lines.zh: 鬓角别剪掉太多，稍微修整一下就好。

lines.en: Would you prefer scissors or clippers on the sides?
lines.zh: 两侧你希望用剪刀还是推剪？

lines.en: Does the price include a wash and blow-dry?
lines.zh: 这个价格包含洗发和吹整吗？
lines.note: blow-dry 指用吹风机吹干或吹整；dry cut 指在干发状态剪发，服务范围要单独问。

lines.en: Could you show me the back with a mirror?
lines.zh: 能用镜子让我看看后面吗？

lines.en: Could you take a little more off around the ears?
lines.zh: 耳朵周围能再修短一点吗？

dialogues.title: 预约并确认服务
dialogues.subtitle: 确定时间，问清价格包含什么

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to book a haircut for Saturday afternoon.
lines.zh: 你好，我想预约周六下午理发。

lines.en: We have a slot at three. Would that work for you?
lines.zh: 我们三点有空档，你方便吗？

lines.en: Yes, thanks. How much is a trim?
lines.zh: 方便，谢谢。稍微修剪一下多少钱？

lines.en: It's thirty dollars, including a wash and blow-dry.
lines.zh: 三十美元，包含洗发和吹整。

lines.en: Great. Please book me in for three. My name is Alex.
lines.zh: 好的，请帮我约三点。我叫 Alex。

lines.en: You're booked in, Alex. See you on Saturday.
lines.zh: Alex，已帮你预约好，周六见。

dialogues.title: 剪之前确认长度
dialogues.subtitle: 保留头顶和造型，具体说明两侧

lines.en: What would you like to do with your hair today?
lines.zh: 今天想怎么剪？

lines.en: I'd like a trim on the sides, but please keep the shape as it is.
lines.zh: 我想把两侧稍微修一下，但请保留现在的形状。

lines.en: How much would you like taken off?
lines.zh: 你想剪掉多少？

lines.en: About a centimeter on the sides. Please keep the length on top.
lines.zh: 两侧大约剪掉一厘米。请保留头顶的长度。

lines.en: Would you prefer scissors or clippers on the sides?
lines.zh: 两侧希望用剪刀还是推剪？

lines.en: Scissors, please. Just tidy up the sideburns as well.
lines.zh: 请用剪刀，也稍微修整一下鬓角。

lines.en: Sure. I'll show you the length before I start.
lines.zh: 好的，我开始前会先给你确认长度。

lines.en: Thanks. That sounds good.
lines.zh: 谢谢，这样很好。

branches.title: 对方理解成剪短很多
branches.subtitle: 在动手前重新确认

lines.en: So, quite short on top as well?
lines.zh: 所以头顶也剪得挺短，对吗？

lines.en: Actually, please keep the length on top. Just trim the sides.
lines.zh: 其实请保留头顶的长度，只修一下两侧。

lines.en: Got it. About a centimeter off the sides?
lines.zh: 明白，两侧大约剪掉一厘米吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's right. Thanks for checking.
lines.zh: 是的，谢谢你确认。

branches.title: 剪完再做小调整
branches.subtitle: 先看后面，再明确局部

lines.en: How does that look?
lines.zh: 你觉得这样怎么样？

lines.en: Could you show me the back with a mirror?
lines.zh: 能用镜子让我看看后面吗？

lines.en: Of course. Here you go.
lines.zh: 当然，你看。

lines.en: The back looks good. Could you take a little more off around the ears?
lines.zh: 后面很好，耳朵周围能再修短一点吗？

lines.en: Sure, just a little to tidy it up.
lines.zh: 好的，稍微修整一下。

lines.en: Thanks. That's exactly what I wanted.
lines.zh: 谢谢，这就是我想要的效果。

substitutions: 把 Saturday afternoon 换成 Friday morning，询问预约时间。
把 a centimeter 换成 half a centimeter，说明只剪掉半厘米。
把 around the ears 换成 at the back，要求后面再修短一点。
responses: How much would you like taken off?
两侧约一厘米，头顶保留长度。
About a centimeter on the sides. Please keep the length on top.
We have a slot at three.
三点不方便，问四点有没有空。
Three doesn't work for me. Do you have anything at four?
How does that look?
整体满意，但希望耳边再修整。
It looks good. Could you tidy it up a little around the ears?
practice.task: 预约一次理发，问清费用包含什么；到店后说明哪些地方修短、哪些地方保留，结束前检查并提出一个具体调整。

quickReference.note: 通常修掉少量并整理现有发型，仍要说明具体长度和部位。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'd like a trim, please.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我想稍微修剪一下。

quickReference.note: 英式常说 fringe，美式常说 bangs；不是所有发型术语都逐字翻译。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'd like my fringe just above my eyebrows.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我想让刘海刚好在眉毛上方。

quickReference.note: 两侧鬓角通常用复数；只说一侧时也可以说 a sideburn。
quickReference.exampleEn: Not too much off the sideburns. Just tidy them up, please.
quickReference.exampleZh: 鬓角别剪掉太多，稍微修整一下就好。

quickReference.note: 电动推剪常用复数 clippers；卡尺号及长度需要与理发师确认。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you prefer scissors or clippers on the sides?
quickReference.exampleZh: 两侧你希望用剪刀还是推剪？

quickReference.note: dry cut 主要指在干发状态剪发，不自动等于剪发不含吹整。
quickReference.exampleEn: Does the price include a wash and blow-dry?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这个价格包含洗发和吹整吗？

quickReference.note: 用厘米、部位或手势补充 little 的实际范围，避免双方理解不一致。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you take a little more off around the ears?
quickReference.exampleZh: 耳朵周围能再修短一点吗？

chapters.title: 看医生与药房咨询
chapters.task: 说明症状 · 报告过敏 · 确认用药
chapters.example: I've had a sore throat since Monday.
chapters.translation: 我从星期一开始喉咙痛。
chapters.scenario: 星期三联系诊所，说明从星期一开始喉咙痛和流鼻涕，并主动报告药物过敏。另一段练习是在拿到处方后，向药剂师核对用法；不在课文中设定通用剂量或替你判断疾病。
phrases: a sore throat 喉咙痛
a runny nose 流鼻涕
be allergic to 对……过敏
a prescription 处方
take it with food 随餐服用
side effects 副作用

lines.en: I've had a sore throat since Monday.
lines.zh: 我从星期一开始喉咙痛。
lines.note: have had ... since ... 表示从某个时间开始并持续到现在；持续时长可以用 for two days。

lines.en: I've also got a runny nose.
lines.zh: 我还流鼻涕。

lines.en: How long have you been feeling like this?
lines.zh: 你这种不舒服持续多久了？

lines.en: It started two days ago.
lines.zh: 是两天前开始的。

lines.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.
lines.zh: 我对青霉素过敏。
lines.note: 报告已知过敏，不用这个句型自行判断过敏；不知道药名时请对方查阅记录或包装。

lines.en: Are you taking any medication at the moment?
lines.zh: 你现在有在用什么药吗？

lines.en: I've brought a list of the medicines I take.
lines.zh: 我带来了我正在用的药物清单。

lines.en: Could I speak to a pharmacist, please?
lines.zh: 我能和药剂师咨询一下吗？

lines.en: How often should I take it?
lines.zh: 我应该多久服用一次？
lines.note: 向专业人员核对频率；how much 问每次用量，两者不是同一个问题。

lines.en: Should I take it with food?
lines.zh: 我应该随餐服用吗？

lines.en: Are there any side effects I should watch out for?
lines.zh: 有什么副作用是我应该留意的吗？
lines.note: watch out for 指留意可能出现的问题；与药物有关的具体判断由医生或药剂师说明。

lines.en: Could you write the instructions down for me?
lines.zh: 能把使用说明写下来给我吗？

dialogues.title: 在诊所说明症状
dialogues.subtitle: 交代开始时间、伴随症状和已知过敏

lines.en: What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 今天来是哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I've had a sore throat and a runny nose since Monday.
lines.zh: 我从星期一开始喉咙痛和流鼻涕。

lines.en: Have you noticed any other symptoms?
lines.zh: 还注意到其他症状吗？

lines.en: I've been feeling tired as well.
lines.zh: 我还一直觉得疲倦。

lines.en: Are you taking any medication, and do you have any allergies?
lines.zh: 你有在用药吗？有已知过敏吗？

lines.en: I've brought a list of my medicines. I'm allergic to penicillin.
lines.zh: 我带了用药清单。我对青霉素过敏。

lines.en: Thanks for telling me. Let's go through the list before I examine you.
lines.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。检查前我们先看一下这份清单。

lines.en: Of course. Here it is.
lines.zh: 当然，清单在这里。

dialogues.title: 药房核对处方说明
dialogues.subtitle: 问频率、随餐要求和书面说明

lines.en: Hi, I have a prescription. Could I speak to a pharmacist?
lines.zh: 你好，我有一张处方，能咨询一下药剂师吗？

lines.en: Of course. What would you like to check?
lines.zh: 当然，你想确认什么？

lines.en: How often should I take it, and should I take it with food?
lines.zh: 我应该多久服用一次？需要随餐服用吗？

lines.en: Let's check the instructions on your prescription together.
lines.zh: 我们一起核对你这张处方上的说明。

lines.en: Are there any side effects I should watch out for?
lines.zh: 有什么副作用是我应该留意的吗？

lines.en: I'll go through the relevant section of the leaflet with you.
lines.zh: 我会和你一起看说明书中相关的部分。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you write the key instructions down for me?
lines.zh: 谢谢，能把主要使用说明写下来给我吗？

lines.en: Yes. Then I'll ask you to repeat them back so we can check they're clear.
lines.zh: 可以，然后请你复述一遍，我们确认你听明白了。

branches.title: 当天预约已满
branches.subtitle: 问可用时间和当地咨询渠道

lines.en: Do you have any appointments available today?
lines.zh: 今天还有可以预约的时间吗？

lines.en: We're fully booked today. We have a slot tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 今天约满了，明天上午还有一个空档。

lines.en: If I need advice before then, which service should I contact?
lines.zh: 如果在那之前需要咨询，我应该联系哪个服务？

lines.en: Let me give you the details of the local medical advice service.
lines.zh: 我把当地医疗咨询服务的联系方式给你。

branches.title: 没听清用量和频率
branches.subtitle: 请对方慢说并写下来

lines.en: Do you have any questions about the instructions?
lines.zh: 你对使用说明有什么问题吗？

lines.en: Sorry, I didn't catch the amount or how often to take it. Could you go over that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思，我没听清每次用量和服用频率，能再讲一遍吗？

lines.en: Of course. I'll explain it more slowly.
lines.zh: 当然，我会说慢一点。

lines.en: Could you write it down as well? I want to make sure I follow it correctly.
lines.zh: 也能写下来吗？我想确保正确按说明使用。

substitutions: 把 a sore throat 换成 a cough，说明从星期一开始咳嗽。
把 since Monday 换成 for two days，表达持续两天。
把 How often 换成 How much，问清每次用量，并再单独问频率。
responses: How long have you been feeling like this?
从星期一开始。
I've been feeling like this since Monday.
Do you have any allergies?
报告你已经知道的青霉素过敏。
Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
Do you have any questions about the instructions?
没听懂随餐要求，请再解释。
I'm not sure whether to take it with food. Could you explain that again?
practice.task: 用三句说明症状、开始时间和已知过敏；向药剂师问清每次用量、频率和随餐要求，没听懂时请求书面说明。不要自行填一个固定剂量。

quickReference.note: 这是症状描述，不等于已经确诊 throat infection 喉咙感染。
quickReference.exampleEn: I've had a sore throat since Monday.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我从星期一开始喉咙痛。

quickReference.note: 鼻塞可以说 a blocked nose；两种症状可以同时出现，不是反义词。
quickReference.exampleEn: I've also got a runny nose.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我还流鼻涕。

quickReference.note: allergic 是形容词，allergy 是名词；报告已知过敏，并提供实际药物名称。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'm allergic to penicillin.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我对青霉素过敏。

quickReference.note: 处方和药品说明书 leaflet 不同；用法应向医生或药剂师核实。
quickReference.exampleEn: Hi, I have a prescription. Could I speak to a pharmacist?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你好，我有一张处方，能咨询一下药剂师吗？

quickReference.note: 人是 pharmacist，药房是 pharmacy；不要把机构和职业混淆。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could I speak to a pharmacist, please?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我能和药剂师咨询一下吗？

quickReference.note: side effect 与药物过敏反应不是同义词；问应留意什么，不用例句自行诊断。
quickReference.exampleEn: Are there any side effects I should watch out for?
quickReference.exampleZh: 有什么副作用是我应该留意的吗？

chapters.title: 健身房与器械使用
chapters.task: 咨询会籍 · 请教器械 · 暂停会籍
chapters.example: Could you show me how to adjust this squat rack?
chapters.translation: 能教我怎么调节这个深蹲架吗？
chapters.scenario: 你想了解一家健身房的月费和课程，先试用再决定。训练时请工作人员演示器械调节，并礼貌询问其他人还剩几组；会籍暂停条件只属于本练习中的健身房。
phrases: a monthly membership 月度会籍
a joining fee 入会费
a trial session 体验一次
adjust the squat rack 调节深蹲架
sets and reps 组数和每组次数
freeze a membership 暂停会籍

lines.en: Could you show me how to adjust this squat rack?
lines.zh: 能教我怎么调节这个深蹲架吗？
lines.note: adjust 指调整高度或位置；先请工作人员演示，不把语言例句当训练教程。

lines.en: How much is a monthly membership?
lines.zh: 月度会籍多少钱？

lines.en: Is there a joining fee?
lines.zh: 需要交入会费吗？

lines.en: Are classes included in the membership?
lines.zh: 会籍包含课程吗？

lines.en: Could I book a trial session before I decide?
lines.zh: 决定前我能预约体验一次吗？

lines.en: Do I need to book this class in advance?
lines.zh: 这节课需要提前预约吗？

lines.en: I'm new to this equipment.
lines.zh: 我第一次用这套器械。

lines.en: Could you check that this is set up correctly?
lines.zh: 能帮我确认这样设置对不对吗？

lines.en: Are you using this?
lines.zh: 你正在用这个吗？
lines.note: 指着双方明确的器械询问是否有人在用；确认得到回应后再使用。

lines.en: How many sets do you have left?
lines.zh: 你还剩几组？
lines.note: a set 是一组，a rep 是一次重复动作；问剩余组数不等于催对方马上让开。

lines.en: Can I freeze my membership while I am away for a month?
lines.zh: 我外出一个月期间可以暂停会籍吗？
lines.note: freeze membership 常指临时暂停；与 cancel 取消不同，是否收费、期限和通知要求要问清。

lines.en: How much notice do I need to give?
lines.zh: 我需要提前多久通知？

dialogues.title: 入会前确认总费用
dialogues.subtitle: 问月费、入会费和体验安排

lines.en: Hi, I'm interested in joining. How much is a monthly membership?
lines.zh: 你好，我想了解入会。月度会籍多少钱？

lines.en: It's forty dollars a month.
lines.zh: 每月四十美元。

lines.en: Is there a joining fee, and are classes included?
lines.zh: 需要入会费吗？课程包含在里面吗？

lines.en: There is no joining fee. Some classes cost extra.
lines.zh: 没有入会费，有些课程需要另付费。

lines.en: Could I book a trial session before I decide?
lines.zh: 决定前我能预约体验一次吗？

lines.en: Yes, we offer a free trial. Would tomorrow at six work?
lines.zh: 可以，我们提供一次免费体验。明天六点方便吗？

lines.en: Yes, thanks. What should I bring?
lines.zh: 方便，谢谢。我应该带什么？

lines.en: A towel, water and suitable shoes. We will show you around first.
lines.zh: 毛巾、水和合适的运动鞋，我们会先带你参观。

dialogues.title: 请教器械并等待使用
dialogues.subtitle: 先在空架上接受演示；稍后在训练区询问另一架的使用情况

lines.en: Excuse me, I'm new to this equipment. Could you show me how to adjust this squat rack?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我第一次用这个器械，能教我怎么调节深蹲架吗？

lines.en: Of course. I will demonstrate on the empty rack over here.
lines.zh: 当然，我在这边的空架上演示。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you show me how to check that it is set up correctly?
lines.zh: 谢谢，能教我怎么检查它设置得对不对吗？

lines.en: Yes. Let us go through the checks, including the safety supports.
lines.zh: 可以，我们一起过一遍检查步骤，包括安全支撑。

lines.en: Excuse me, are you using this rack?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你正在用这个架子吗？

lines.en: Yes, I am.
lines.zh: 是的，我在用。

lines.en: How many sets do you have left?
lines.zh: 你还剩几组？

lines.en: Just one more.
lines.zh: 还剩最后一组。

lines.en: No problem. I will wait over here.
lines.zh: 没问题，我在这边等。

lines.en: Thanks. I will let you know when I am done.
lines.zh: 谢谢，结束后我告诉你。

branches.title: 想上的课需要另付费
branches.subtitle: 确认单次费用后再决定

lines.en: Is the evening yoga class included?
lines.zh: 晚上的瑜伽课包含在会籍里吗？

lines.en: No, that class is five dollars per session.
lines.zh: 不包含，那节课每次五美元。

lines.en: Can I book just one session to try it?
lines.zh: 我能先只预约一次体验吗？

lines.en: Yes. You can book a single session at reception.
lines.zh: 可以，你可以在前台预约单次课程。

branches.title: 外出期间暂停会籍
branches.subtitle: 核对收费、通知时间和恢复日期

lines.en: Can I freeze my membership while I am away for a month?
lines.zh: 我外出一个月期间可以暂停会籍吗？

lines.en: Yes. There is a five-dollar freeze fee, and we need seven days of notice.
lines.zh: 可以，暂停费五美元，需要提前七天通知。

lines.en: When would the membership restart?
lines.zh: 会籍什么时候恢复？

lines.en: On the date you choose. I can send you the terms before you apply.
lines.zh: 在你选定的日期恢复，申请前我可以把条款发给你。

lines.en: Thanks. Please send them to me first.
lines.zh: 谢谢，请先把条款发给我。

substitutions: 把 monthly membership 换成 day pass，问单日使用费用。
把 squat rack 换成 exercise bike，请工作人员演示调节。
把 a month 换成 two weeks，问暂停两周的条件。
responses: Would tomorrow at six work?
六点不方便，提议七点。
Could we make it seven instead?
Just one more set.
表示愿意等，请对方结束后告诉你。
No problem. Could you let me know when you are done?
Some classes cost extra.
问瑜伽课单次多少钱。
How much is a single yoga session?
practice.task: 咨询入会总费用和课程范围，预约体验；请工作人员演示器械，礼貌询问他人是否使用；最后问清暂停会籍的条件。

quickReference.note: 会籍与实体会员卡不同；咨询服务和费用时用 membership。
quickReference.exampleEn: How much is a monthly membership?
quickReference.exampleZh: 月度会籍多少钱？

quickReference.note: 一次性入会费与月费 monthly fee 不同，应分别问清。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a joining fee?
quickReference.exampleZh: 需要交入会费吗？

quickReference.note: 器械调节需请工作人员演示；这里练询问，不提供训练动作指导。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you show me how to adjust this squat rack?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能教我怎么调节这个深蹲架吗？

quickReference.note: a set 是一组，a rep 是一次重复；three sets of ten reps 是三组，每组十次。
quickReference.exampleEn: How many sets do you have left?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你还剩几组？

quickReference.note: freeze 通常是暂时停用；cancel 是取消，收费及恢复时间要问清。
quickReference.exampleEn: Can I freeze my membership while I am away for a month?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我外出一个月期间可以暂停会籍吗？

quickReference.note: How much notice 问要提前多久告知，不是要多少张通知单。
quickReference.exampleEn: How much notice do I need to give?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我需要提前多久通知？

chapters.title: 网购客服与退款跟进
chapters.task: 描述订单问题 · 选择处理方式 · 跟进退款
chapters.example: One item was missing from the box.
chapters.translation: 箱子里少了一件商品。
chapters.scenario: 你网购了两件商品，但箱子里只有一件，通过在线客服报订单号并申请缺失商品退款。另一个练习发生在商家批准退款后，追问入账时间；退款范围和时限由对话里的客服确认。
phrases: an order number 订单号
a missing item 缺失的商品
proof of purchase 购买凭证
a replacement 替换或补发商品
process a refund 处理退款
business days 工作日

lines.en: One item was missing from the box.
lines.zh: 箱子里少了一件商品。

lines.en: My order number is AB4821.
lines.zh: 我的订单号是 AB4821。

lines.en: I ordered two items, but only one arrived.
lines.zh: 我订了两件，但只收到一件。

lines.en: Could you send me a photo of what you received?
lines.zh: 能把你收到的东西拍照发给我吗？

lines.en: Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
lines.zh: 你希望退款还是补发商品？

lines.en: Could I have a full refund rather than a replacement?
lines.zh: 我能要全额退款，而不是换货吗？
lines.note: full refund 的范围要明确：本章缺件对话指缺失那件商品的全额金额，不自动包含整单或运费。

lines.en: Do I need to return the faulty item?
lines.zh: 我需要把有故障的商品寄回吗？

lines.en: Will you provide a prepaid return label?
lines.zh: 你们会提供已付邮资的退货标签吗？
lines.note: prepaid return label 指退货邮资已安排的标签；退货方式和谁承担费用需由商家确认。

lines.en: When should I expect the refund?
lines.zh: 我大概什么时候能收到退款？

lines.en: It should reach your account within five business days.
lines.zh: 预计五个工作日内会退到你的账户。
lines.note: business days 通常不含周末和相关假日；具体起算点、银行和地区规则要确认，should 表示预期。

lines.en: Could you send me written confirmation?
lines.zh: 能给我发一份书面确认吗？

lines.en: I have not received the refund yet.
lines.zh: 我还没有收到退款。

dialogues.title: 收到的商品少了一件
dialogues.subtitle: 报订单号，明确缺件和退款范围

lines.en: Hi, I need help with order AB4821. One item was missing from the box.
lines.zh: 你好，我需要咨询订单 AB4821，箱子里少了一件商品。

lines.en: I can help. Which item was missing?
lines.zh: 我可以帮你，是哪件商品缺了？

lines.en: The blue mug. The green one arrived.
lines.zh: 蓝色杯子没收到，绿色的收到了。

lines.en: Thanks. Would you prefer a refund or a replacement for the blue mug?
lines.zh: 谢谢，你希望蓝色杯子退款还是补发？

lines.en: Could I have a full refund for the missing mug rather than a replacement?
lines.zh: 缺失的杯子能给我全额退款，而不是补发吗？

lines.en: Yes. That is twelve dollars, returned to your original payment method.
lines.zh: 可以，是十二美元，退回原付款方式。

lines.en: When should I expect it?
lines.zh: 预计什么时候能收到？

lines.en: Within five business days of processing. I will send you confirmation today.
lines.zh: 处理完成后五个工作日内，我今天会发确认给你。

dialogues.title: 跟进已经批准的退款
dialogues.subtitle: 确认处理日期和可追踪凭证

lines.en: Hi, my refund was approved last Monday, but I have not received it yet.
lines.zh: 你好，我的退款上周一就批准了，但还没有收到。

lines.en: Could you give me your order number?
lines.zh: 能告诉我订单号吗？

lines.en: It is CD7392. Could you check whether the refund has been processed?
lines.zh: 是 CD7392，能查一下退款是否已经处理了吗？

lines.en: It was processed on Wednesday. That is when the five-business-day window started.
lines.zh: 周三已处理，五个工作日的时限是从那时开始算的。

lines.en: Could you send me the refund reference and the expected arrival date?
lines.zh: 能把退款参考编号和预计到账日期发给我吗？

lines.en: Yes. I will send them in this chat with the processing confirmation.
lines.zh: 可以，我会在这个聊天里连同处理确认一起发给你。

lines.en: Thanks. If it does not arrive by then, should I contact you again?
lines.zh: 谢谢，如果到那时还没收到，我应该再联系你们吗？

lines.en: Yes. Please quote the reference so we can follow up.
lines.zh: 是的，请提供参考编号，我们好继续跟进。

branches.title: 客服需要购买凭证
branches.subtitle: 确认订单邮件是否可用

lines.en: We need proof of purchase before we can review the request.
lines.zh: 审核申请前，我们需要购买凭证。

lines.en: Would the order confirmation email be enough?
lines.zh: 订单确认邮件可以吗？

lines.en: Yes, if it shows the order number and the item.
lines.zh: 可以，只要能看到订单号和商品。

lines.en: I have it here. Where should I upload it?
lines.zh: 我这里有，应该上传到哪里？

lines.en: You can attach it in this chat.
lines.zh: 可以作为附件发到这个聊天里。

branches.title: 约定时限过去仍没到账
branches.subtitle: 要求追踪和明确下次回复时间

lines.en: The five-business-day window has passed, and I still have not received the refund.
lines.zh: 五个工作日的时限已经过了，我仍没收到退款。

lines.en: I am sorry about that. I will ask our payments team to check.
lines.zh: 很抱歉，我会请支付团队核查。

lines.en: When can I expect an update, and could you give me a case number?
lines.zh: 预计什么时候会有进展？能给我一个处理编号吗？

lines.en: Your case number is R215. We will update you within two business days.
lines.zh: 处理编号是 R215，我们会在两个工作日内回复进展。

lines.en: Thank you. Please confirm that in writing.
lines.zh: 谢谢，请把这些安排书面确认给我。

substitutions: 把 blue mug 换成 phone case，说明缺失商品。
把 a refund 换成 a replacement，表达希望补发，并问预计到达时间。
把 five business days 换成 three business days，确认客服给出的处理时限。
responses: Which item was missing?
蓝色杯子缺失，绿色杯子收到了。
The blue mug was missing. The green one arrived.
Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
选择退款，并明确是缺失商品的全额金额。
A full refund for the missing item, please.
We need proof of purchase.
问订单确认邮件是否足够。
Would the order confirmation email be enough?
practice.task: 报告一个线上订单问题，提供订单号、商品和事实，选择处理方式，问清金额、费用和时间；对方给出模糊回复时争取书面确认和下次更新时间。

quickReference.note: 描述少了一件商品；is missing 和 was missing 根据时间使用，不保证某时态更容易索赔。
quickReference.exampleEn: One item was missing from the box.
quickReference.exampleZh: 箱子里少了一件商品。

quickReference.note: 这里按名词标注；full refund 要说明是缺失商品、整单还是包含运费。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你希望退款还是补发商品？

quickReference.note: a replacement 是一个替代品；若想要相同商品可说明同款、颜色和数量。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你希望退款还是补发商品？

quickReference.note: 电子订单或小票是否接受由商家确认；不要直接说 buying proof。
quickReference.exampleEn: We need proof of purchase before we can review the request.
quickReference.exampleZh: 审核申请前，我们需要购买凭证。

quickReference.note: 通常不含周末和相关假日；批准退款与实际处理的起算时间可能不同。
quickReference.exampleEn: It should reach your account within five business days.
quickReference.exampleZh: 预计五个工作日内会退到你的账户。

quickReference.note: 确认金额、处理日期和下次更新时间，比只收到一句“已处理”更清楚。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you send me written confirmation?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能给我发一份书面确认吗？

chapters.title: 手机维修与报价确认
chapters.task: 描述故障 · 确认费用 · 保护数据
chapters.example: Can you give me a repair quote first?
chapters.translation: 能先给我一份维修报价吗？
chapters.scenario: 你想修一部碎屏手机，先问报价、数据影响和维修时间。另一个练习是手机进水后反复重启，先安排检测并约定未经确认不开始维修；费用、配件和保修都是虚构商店的条件。
phrases: a cracked screen 碎裂的屏幕
a repair quote 维修报价
a diagnostic fee 检测费
back up my data 备份我的数据
replacement parts 替换零件
a repair warranty 维修保修

lines.en: Can you give me a repair quote first?
lines.zh: 能先给我一份维修报价吗？
lines.note: quote 指针对这次维修的报价；初步 estimate 可能是估算，应问清是否确定以及包含哪些费用。

lines.en: The screen is cracked, but the phone still turns on.
lines.zh: 屏幕裂了，但手机还能开机。

lines.en: The touch screen is not responding properly.
lines.zh: 触摸屏的反应不正常。

lines.en: My phone got wet, and now it keeps restarting.
lines.zh: 我的手机进水了，现在一直重启。

lines.en: When did the problem start?
lines.zh: 问题是什么时候开始的？

lines.en: Is there a diagnostic fee if I decide not to repair it?
lines.zh: 如果我最后决定不修，需要付检测费吗？

lines.en: Does the quote include parts and labor?
lines.zh: 报价包含零件和人工吗？

lines.en: How long will the repair take?
lines.zh: 维修需要多长时间？

lines.en: Will the repair affect my data?
lines.zh: 维修会影响我的数据吗？
lines.note: 先确认是否有清除或丢失数据的可能，不把店员能够访问或备份个人数据当成默认条件。

lines.en: I'll back up my data before I bring it in.
lines.zh: 我送来之前会先备份数据。
lines.note: 这是设备仍可正常备份时的计划；设备无法使用时可说 I have not been able to back up my data. 并先核对处理方案。

lines.en: Is there a warranty on the repair?
lines.zh: 这次维修有保修吗？

lines.en: Please contact me before doing any extra work.
lines.zh: 做任何额外维修前，请先联系我。
lines.note: 说明授权范围；可以补上 Please do not start until I approve the quote.，明确先批准报价再动工。

dialogues.title: 碎屏手机询价
dialogues.subtitle: 确认总价、数据影响和维修时间

lines.en: Hi, the screen is cracked, but the phone still turns on. Can you give me a repair quote first?
lines.zh: 你好，屏幕裂了，但手机还能开机。能先给我维修报价吗？

lines.en: For this model, a screen replacement is ninety dollars.
lines.zh: 这个型号换屏是九十美元。

lines.en: Does that include parts and labor, and will the repair affect my data?
lines.zh: 包含零件和人工吗？维修会影响我的数据吗？

lines.en: It includes both. We do not expect to erase your data, but you should back it up first.
lines.zh: 两项都包含，预计不需要清除数据，但你应该先备份。

lines.en: I'll back up my data before I bring it in. How long will the repair take?
lines.zh: 我送来前会先备份数据。维修需要多久？

lines.en: About two hours once we have the part. There is a three-month warranty on the replacement screen.
lines.zh: 配件到位后大约两小时，更换的屏幕有三个月保修。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you send me the quote and warranty terms before I book?
lines.zh: 谢谢，我预约前能把报价和保修条款发给我吗？

lines.en: Of course. I will also confirm whether the part is in stock.
lines.zh: 当然，我也会确认配件有没有库存。

dialogues.title: 先检测，再决定维修
dialogues.subtitle: 报告进水和重启，明确授权范围

lines.en: My phone got wet yesterday, and now it keeps restarting.
lines.zh: 我的手机昨天进水了，现在一直重启。

lines.en: We will need to inspect it before we can give you a repair quote.
lines.zh: 我们需要先检测才能给你维修报价。

lines.en: Is there a diagnostic fee if I decide not to repair it?
lines.zh: 如果我最后不修，要付检测费吗？

lines.en: Yes, twenty dollars. If you go ahead with the repair, that fee is included in the total.
lines.zh: 要，二十美元。如果继续维修，这笔费用包含在总价里。

lines.en: I have not been able to back up my data. Please tell me if the proposed work could erase it.
lines.zh: 我还没能备份数据。如果拟做的维修可能清除数据，请告诉我。

lines.en: Understood. We will explain the options after the inspection.
lines.zh: 明白，检测后我们会说明可选方案。

lines.en: Please do not start the repair until I approve the quote.
lines.zh: 我批准报价前，请不要开始维修。

lines.en: Of course. We will contact you first.
lines.zh: 当然，我们会先联系你。

branches.title: 配件暂时缺货
branches.subtitle: 问到货时间，再决定是否留下手机

lines.en: The replacement screen is out of stock. It should arrive on Thursday.
lines.zh: 替换屏幕缺货了，预计周四到。

lines.en: Can I keep using my phone and bring it in once the part arrives?
lines.zh: 我能先继续用手机，等配件到了再送来吗？

lines.en: Let me check whether it is safe to keep using it before I advise you.
lines.zh: 我先确认是否适合继续使用，再给你建议。

lines.en: Thanks. Please contact me when the part is available.
lines.zh: 谢谢，配件到货后请联系我。

branches.title: 检测后的费用超出预算
branches.subtitle: 确认只做检测，暂不维修

lines.en: The total repair cost would be one hundred and eighty dollars.
lines.zh: 维修总价是一百八十美元。

lines.en: That is more than I planned to spend. I would like to think it over.
lines.zh: 这超过了我的预算，我想再考虑一下。

lines.en: Of course. Only the agreed twenty-dollar diagnostic fee is due for now.
lines.zh: 当然，目前只需付约定的二十美元检测费。

lines.en: Please do not go ahead with the repair. Could I collect the phone today?
lines.zh: 请先不要维修。我今天能来取手机吗？

lines.en: Yes. It will be ready to collect after three.
lines.zh: 可以，三点之后可以来取。

substitutions: 把 cracked screen 换成 damaged charging port，说明充电接口损坏并询价。
把 parts and labor 换成 tax，单独确认报价是否含税。
把 two hours 换成 three days，复述维修周期并问何时能取。
responses: When did the problem start?
昨天进水后开始反复重启。
It started after my phone got wet yesterday. It keeps restarting.
We need to inspect it first.
确认不修是否也收检测费。
Is there a diagnostic fee if I decide not to repair it?
The total would be one hundred and eighty dollars.
超过预算，暂不授权维修。
That is more than I planned to spend. Please do not start the repair yet.
practice.task: 描述一种手机故障，确认检测费、零件和人工、数据影响及取机时间；收到超预算报价时明确暂不授权维修。

quickReference.note: cracked 描述裂纹；是否还能显示和触控要另说，不能只靠一个形容词判断故障。
quickReference.exampleEn: The screen is cracked, but the phone still turns on.
quickReference.exampleZh: 屏幕裂了，但手机还能开机。

quickReference.note: quote 是报价；estimate 可能是估算，应确认费用范围和是否还会变动。
quickReference.exampleEn: Can you give me a repair quote first?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能先给我一份维修报价吗？

quickReference.note: 是否不修也收费、修理时是否计入总价，均需事先确认。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a diagnostic fee if I decide not to repair it?
quickReference.exampleZh: 如果我最后决定不修，需要付检测费吗？

quickReference.note: labor 是美式拼写，英式写 labour；报价是否还含税费要单独确认。
quickReference.exampleEn: Does the quote include parts and labor?
quickReference.exampleZh: 报价包含零件和人工吗？

quickReference.note: back up 是动词短语，backup 可作名词或形容词；不能默认维修店会替你备份。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'll back up my data before I bring it in.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我送来之前会先备份数据。

quickReference.note: 问清期限和覆盖范围；warranty 与 guarantee 的用法有重叠，不按服务商和厂商一刀切。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a warranty on the repair?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这次维修有保修吗？

chapters.title: 打电话办事与留言
chapters.task: 说明来意 · 留言 · 核对信息
chapters.example: Could you put me through to the booking desk?
chapters.translation: 能帮我转接预约服务台吗？
chapters.scenario: 你致电活动中心，想找预约服务台更改周五的场地预约。工作人员不在时留下姓名和回电时段；另一段练习是电话断线后重新联系。电话号码使用说明性占位，不填写真实联系方式。
phrases: put me through 转接我的电话
the booking desk 预约服务台
leave a message 留言
call me back 给我回电话
read it back 读回信息以核对
get cut off 通话被中断

lines.en: Could you put me through to the booking desk?
lines.zh: 能帮我转接预约服务台吗？
lines.note: put someone through to ... 指转接电话；不是让对方把物品递过来。

lines.en: I am calling about my booking for Friday.
lines.zh: 我打来是想询问周五的预约。

lines.en: Is now a good time to talk?
lines.zh: 现在方便说话吗？

lines.en: Could I leave a message?
lines.zh: 我可以留个言吗？

lines.en: Could you ask them to call me back?
lines.zh: 能请他们给我回电话吗？
lines.note: call me back 中 me 放在 call 和 back 之间；回电时段应说明上午或下午。

lines.en: My name is Alex Chen. Chen is C-H-E-N.
lines.zh: 我叫 Alex Chen，Chen 拼作 C-H-E-N。

lines.en: Let me give you my callback number.
lines.zh: 我把回电号码告诉你。

lines.en: Could you read that back to me?
lines.zh: 能把记下的信息读给我确认一下吗？
lines.note: read back 用于核对已记录的信息；repeat 也能请对方重复，但不一定表示核对记录。

lines.en: I will be available between two and four this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午两点到四点方便接电话。

lines.en: Sorry, we got cut off.
lines.zh: 不好意思，刚才电话断了。

lines.en: Could you repeat the last part more slowly?
lines.zh: 最后那部分能再慢一点说一次吗？

lines.en: Could you send the confirmation by email?
lines.zh: 能通过邮件发送确认信息吗？

dialogues.title: 转接与回电留言
dialogues.subtitle: 给出具体事项和可联系时段

lines.en: Hello. Could you put me through to the booking desk?
lines.zh: 你好，能帮我转接预约服务台吗？

lines.en: They are helping another customer. Could I take a message?
lines.zh: 他们正在帮助另一位顾客，我可以替你留言吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. I am calling about my booking for Friday.
lines.zh: 可以，谢谢。我想询问周五的预约。

lines.en: May I have your name and callback number?
lines.zh: 可以告诉我姓名和回电号码吗？

lines.en: My name is Alex Chen. Chen is C-H-E-N. Let me give you my callback number.
lines.zh: 我叫 Alex Chen，Chen 拼作 C-H-E-N。我把回电号码告诉你。

lines.en: Thank you. When would be a good time to call?
lines.zh: 谢谢，什么时候回电方便？

lines.en: I will be available between two and four this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午两点到四点方便接电话。

lines.en: I will pass that message on to the booking desk.
lines.zh: 我会把留言转给预约服务台。

dialogues.title: 断线后重新确认
dialogues.subtitle: 说明之前说到哪里，核对最终结果

lines.en: Hi, this is Alex again. Sorry, we got cut off.
lines.zh: 你好，又是 Alex，不好意思，刚才电话断了。

lines.en: No problem. We were checking whether you could move your booking to Saturday.
lines.zh: 没关系，我们刚才在查能否把你的预约改到周六。

lines.en: That is right. Is the ten o’clock slot available?
lines.zh: 对的，十点的时段有空吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have moved it to Saturday at ten in the morning.
lines.zh: 有空，我已改到周六上午十点。

lines.en: Could you read that back to me and send the confirmation by email?
lines.zh: 能把预约信息读给我核对，并通过邮件发送确认吗？

lines.en: Saturday at ten in the morning, under Alex Chen. I will send the email now.
lines.zh: 周六上午十点，预约人 Alex Chen。我现在发邮件。

branches.title: 只漏听一部分
branches.subtitle: 补问具体时段，不假装听懂

lines.en: They can call you back sometime tomorrow afternoon.
lines.zh: 他们明天下午可以给你回电话。

lines.en: I caught tomorrow, but not the time. Could you repeat the last part more slowly?
lines.zh: 我听到了明天，但没听清时间，最后那部分能慢一点再说一次吗？

lines.en: Tomorrow afternoon. We cannot give an exact time yet.
lines.zh: 明天下午，目前还不能给出准确时间。

lines.en: Thanks. I am only available after three. Could you include that in the message?
lines.zh: 谢谢，我三点以后才方便，能把这一点写进留言吗？

branches.title: 进入语音留言
branches.subtitle: 留下简洁来意和回电安排

lines.en: Please leave your name, contact number and a short message after the tone.
lines.zh: 请在提示音后留下姓名、联系电话和简短留言。

lines.en: Hello, this is Alex Chen. I am calling about my booking for Friday.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Alex Chen，想询问周五的预约。

lines.en: I would like to move it to Saturday morning. Please call me back after two this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我想改到周六上午，请今天下午两点以后给我回电话。

lines.en: I will leave my callback number now. Thank you.
lines.zh: 我现在留下回电号码，谢谢。

substitutions: 把 the booking desk 换成 the reception desk，请转接前台。
把 Friday 换成 Monday，说明预约日期。
把 between two and four 换成 after three，给出回电时间。
responses: Could I take a message?
说明预约事项并请对方回电。
Yes, please. I am calling about my booking. Could you ask them to call me back?
How do you spell your last name?
拼出练习姓名 Chen。
Chen is C-H-E-N.
We cannot give an exact time yet.
说明自己三点以后才方便。
I am only available after three. Could you include that in the message?
practice.task: 打一通改约电话，说明预约日期、姓名和回电时间；模拟漏听信息或电话中断，再复述最终安排。号码和邮箱用虚构占位。

quickReference.note: put someone through to ... 是电话转接，不是 put someone through a test 让人接受测试。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you put me through to the booking desk?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能帮我转接预约服务台吗？

quickReference.note: 电话留言说明姓名、事项和回电安排，不只说 call me。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could I leave a message?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我可以留个言吗？

quickReference.note: 代词 me 放在 call 与 back 中间；和 call back later 稍后再打区分。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you ask them to call me back?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能请他们给我回电话吗？

quickReference.zh: 把记录的信息读回核对
quickReference.note: 这里是现在时或请求中的原形，音标按动词原形，不是过去式读音。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you read that back to me?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能把记下的信息读给我确认一下吗？

quickReference.note: get cut off 表示连接中断；不能直接认定对方故意挂电话。
quickReference.exampleEn: Sorry, we got cut off.
quickReference.exampleZh: 不好意思，刚才电话断了。

quickReference.note: 确认邮件应核对日期、时段和预约人；不是只收到邮件就默认正确。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you send the confirmation by email?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能通过邮件发送确认信息吗？

chapters.title: 租房看房与入住确认
chapters.task: 核对费用 · 查看房屋 · 确认入住
chapters.example: Does the rent include any bills?
chapters.translation: 租金包含哪些账单费用吗？
chapters.scenario: 你预约看一套带部分家具的公寓，核对租金包含的费用、押金和入住日期。看到墙面已有裂痕时请对方记录；签约前要求阅读合同，不把中介的口头介绍当作通用租赁规则。
phrases: monthly rent 月租金
a security deposit 押金
utility bills 水电等公用事业账单
partly furnished 配有部分家具
move in 入住
existing damage 已有损坏

lines.en: Does the rent include any bills?
lines.zh: 租金包含哪些账单费用吗？
lines.note: bills 指各项账单；具体是否含水、电、网络要逐项核对。

lines.en: How much is the security deposit?
lines.zh: 押金是多少？

lines.en: Is the apartment furnished?
lines.zh: 这套公寓配家具吗？

lines.en: Which furniture will stay in the apartment?
lines.zh: 哪些家具会留在公寓里？

lines.en: When would I be able to move in?
lines.zh: 我什么时候可以入住？
lines.note: move in 指入住；move out 指搬离，不是家具移动。

lines.en: How long is the lease?
lines.zh: 租期多长？

lines.en: Could I read the contract before I decide?
lines.zh: 决定之前我可以先阅读合同吗？

lines.en: Are there any other fees?
lines.zh: 还有其他费用吗？

lines.en: There is already a crack in this wall.
lines.zh: 这面墙已经有一道裂痕。

lines.en: Could we record the existing damage before I move in?
lines.zh: 能在我入住前记录已有损坏吗？
lines.note: existing damage 是入住前已有损坏；可要求书面记录和照片，但具体手续要双方确认。

lines.en: This looks different from the photos.
lines.zh: 这里看起来和照片不同。

lines.en: Could you put those terms in writing?
lines.zh: 能把这些条件写下来吗？

dialogues.title: 看房时核对费用
dialogues.subtitle: 问清家具、账单和入住日期

lines.en: Thanks for showing me around. Does the rent include any bills?
lines.zh: 谢谢带我看房，租金包含哪些账单费用吗？

lines.en: Water is included here, but electricity and internet are separate.
lines.zh: 这套房含水费，但电费和网络费另计。

lines.en: How much is the security deposit, and are there any other fees?
lines.zh: 押金是多少，还有其他费用吗？

lines.en: The deposit is one month’s rent. I will send you a full list of charges.
lines.zh: 押金为一个月租金，我会发给你完整费用清单。

lines.en: Which furniture will stay in the apartment?
lines.zh: 哪些家具会留在公寓里？

lines.en: The bed and table will stay. The current tenant owns the sofa.
lines.zh: 床和桌子会留下，沙发属于当前租客。

lines.en: When would I be able to move in?
lines.zh: 我什么时候可以入住？

lines.en: The proposed date is November first, subject to the signed agreement.
lines.zh: 拟定日期是十一月一日，以签署的协议为准。

dialogues.title: 签约前记录房屋状况
dialogues.subtitle: 检查已有损坏，先读合同再决定

lines.en: There is already a crack in this wall.
lines.zh: 这面墙已经有一道裂痕。

lines.en: Thank you for pointing it out. I will ask the owner to check it.
lines.zh: 谢谢指出，我会请房东检查。

lines.en: Could we record the existing damage before I move in?
lines.zh: 能在我入住前记录已有损坏吗？

lines.en: Yes. We can prepare a condition report with photos.
lines.zh: 可以，我们可以准备一份带照片的房屋状况记录。

lines.en: Could I read the contract before I decide?
lines.zh: 决定之前我可以先阅读合同吗？

lines.en: Of course. I will send the draft and the fee list for you to review.
lines.zh: 当然，我会发合同草稿和费用清单供你阅读。

branches.title: 房间与照片不同
branches.subtitle: 确认实际房源，暂缓决定

lines.en: This looks different from the photos. The room in the listing had a balcony.
lines.zh: 这里和照片不同，房源照片里的房间有阳台。

lines.en: Those photos show another unit in this building.
lines.zh: 那些照片展示的是这栋楼的另一套房。

lines.en: Could you send me photos of this exact apartment and its floor plan?
lines.zh: 能发给我这套公寓本身的照片和户型图吗？

lines.en: Yes. Take a look at those before making a decision.
lines.zh: 可以，请看过以后再决定。

branches.title: 费用只作口头说明
branches.subtitle: 把条件落实到书面材料

lines.en: There may also be a cleaning fee when you leave.
lines.zh: 搬离时可能还有清洁费。

lines.en: How is that fee calculated, and where is it stated in the contract?
lines.zh: 这笔费用怎么算，合同哪里写明了？

lines.en: Let me check with the owner before I give you an answer.
lines.zh: 让我先向房东核对，再回复你。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you put those terms in writing before I sign?
lines.zh: 谢谢，能在我签约前把这些条件写下来吗？

substitutions: 把 electricity 换成 heating，询问暖气费用。
把 November first 换成 November fifteenth，确认入住日期。
把 a crack in this wall 换成 a scratch on the floor，记录地板划痕。
responses: The sofa belongs to the current tenant.
确认床和桌子是否留下。
Will the bed and table stay in the apartment?
There may be another fee.
询问金额及合同位置。
How much is it, and where is it stated in the contract?
Would you like to sign today?
先看合同，不立即承诺。
I would like to read the contract before I decide.
practice.task: 看房时核对租金、押金、账单和家具，记录一个已有问题；要求合同和费用清单，说明自己何时能决定，不自行假设押金退还规则。

quickReference.note: the rent 是租金；rent an apartment 是租房。明确哪些费用包含在内。
quickReference.exampleEn: Does the rent include any bills?
quickReference.exampleZh: 租金包含哪些账单费用吗？

quickReference.note: 押金不等于租金；退还条件和扣费规则要看实际协议。
quickReference.exampleEn: How much is the security deposit?
quickReference.exampleZh: 押金是多少？

quickReference.note: furnished 不保证包含所有看到的家具，要确认哪些会留下。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is the apartment furnished?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这套公寓配家具吗？

quickReference.note: 本章问 How long is the lease? 是问协议约定的租期，不是所有地区统一期限。
quickReference.exampleEn: How long is the lease?
quickReference.exampleZh: 租期多长？

quickReference.note: move in 是搬入，move out 是搬离；问清可入住日期。
quickReference.exampleEn: When would I be able to move in?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我什么时候可以入住？

quickReference.note: damage 表示损坏时通常不可数；记录现状，避免只靠口头承诺。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could we record the existing damage before I move in?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能在我入住前记录已有损坏吗？

chapters.title: 家里报修与预约上门
chapters.task: 描述故障 · 约上门 · 确认费用
chapters.example: The pipe under the sink keeps leaking.
chapters.translation: 水槽下面的管道一直漏水。
chapters.scenario: 家中水槽下方管道持续漏水，你向物业报修并预约周四上门。另一段练习是空调运行几分钟后停机，请维修人员先检查并报价；费用和维修责任由物业或服务方确认。
phrases: keep dripping 一直滴水
a repair visit 上门维修
a call-out fee 上门费
an inspection 检查
approve the quote 确认报价
shut off 自动停止或关闭

lines.en: The pipe under the sink keeps leaking.
lines.zh: 水槽下面的管道一直漏水。
lines.note: pipe 指管道；说明位置和实际表现，比只说 broken 更便于安排检查。

lines.en: It started yesterday evening.
lines.zh: 是昨天晚上开始的。

lines.en: Could you arrange a repair visit?
lines.zh: 能安排一次上门维修吗？

lines.en: Will someone need to be home?
lines.zh: 需要有人在家吗？

lines.en: Is there a call-out fee?
lines.zh: 有上门费吗？
lines.note: call-out fee 指上门服务费用，是否包含检测或人工需要另外确认。

lines.en: Could you give me a time window for the visit?
lines.zh: 能告诉我上门的大致时间段吗？

lines.en: Please call before you arrive.
lines.zh: 到达之前请先打电话。

lines.en: It works for a few minutes, then shuts off.
lines.zh: 它运行几分钟后就停了。

lines.en: The problem does not happen every time.
lines.zh: 这个问题不是每次都会出现。

lines.en: I have a video showing the problem.
lines.zh: 我有一段展示故障的视频。

lines.en: Please do not start the repair until I approve the quote.
lines.zh: 我确认报价之前，请不要开始维修。
lines.note: until 在这里设置开始维修的条件；应分清授权检查与授权维修。

lines.en: The same problem has come back.
lines.zh: 同样的问题又出现了。

dialogues.title: 报修并约上门时段
dialogues.subtitle: 提供位置、开始时间和到访安排

lines.en: Hello. The pipe under the sink keeps leaking. It started yesterday evening.
lines.zh: 你好，水槽下面的管道一直漏水，是昨天晚上开始的。

lines.en: Which apartment are you in?
lines.zh: 你住哪套公寓？

lines.en: Apartment four B. Could you arrange a repair visit?
lines.zh: 4B，能安排一次上门维修吗？

lines.en: A plumber can visit on Thursday between nine and eleven.
lines.zh: 水管工可以周四九点到十一点之间上门。

lines.en: Will someone need to be home, and is there a call-out fee?
lines.zh: 需要有人在家吗，有上门费吗？

lines.en: Someone needs to let them in. I will confirm any charge before the visit.
lines.zh: 需要有人开门，我会在上门前确认是否收费。

lines.en: That works. Please call before you arrive.
lines.zh: 可以，到达之前请先打电话。

lines.en: I have added that note to the booking.
lines.zh: 我已经把这项要求记到预约里。

dialogues.title: 先检查再决定维修
dialogues.subtitle: 描述间歇性问题，明确授权范围

lines.en: What happens when you turn on the air conditioning?
lines.zh: 打开空调后会发生什么？

lines.en: It works for a few minutes, then shuts off. The problem does not happen every time.
lines.zh: 它运行几分钟后就停了，但不是每次都会这样。

lines.en: We will need to inspect it to find the cause.
lines.zh: 我们需要检查才能找到原因。

lines.en: I have a video showing the problem. Is the inspection included in the call-out fee?
lines.zh: 我有一段故障视频，检查包含在上门费里吗？

lines.en: Yes, for this visit. Parts and repair work would be quoted separately.
lines.zh: 这次包含，配件和维修另行报价。

lines.en: Please do not start the repair until I approve the quote.
lines.zh: 我确认报价之前，请不要开始维修。

branches.title: 超过预约时间
branches.subtitle: 询问更新时间，说明自己的限制

lines.en: The plumber has not arrived, and it is already eleven thirty.
lines.zh: 水管工还没到，现在已经十一点半了。

lines.en: The earlier visit took longer than expected. They should arrive after twelve.
lines.zh: 之前那单用时比预期长，他们预计十二点以后到。

lines.en: I need to leave at twelve. Could we arrange another time window?
lines.zh: 我十二点要出门，能另约一个时间段吗？

lines.en: Yes. Let me check the next available slot with you.
lines.zh: 可以，我和你一起确认下一个可用时段。

branches.title: 同样的故障再次出现
branches.subtitle: 说明此前维修，不自行假设免费

lines.en: The same problem has come back since the repair on Thursday.
lines.zh: 周四维修后，同样的问题又出现了。

lines.en: Could you describe what you are seeing now?
lines.zh: 能描述一下现在出现的情况吗？

lines.en: It still shuts off after a few minutes. Could you check the previous repair record and any follow-up charge?
lines.zh: 仍然是几分钟后停机，能查一下之前的维修记录及再次上门是否收费吗？

lines.en: I will review the record and confirm that before booking another visit.
lines.zh: 我会查记录，并在再次预约前确认。

substitutions: 把 the pipe under the sink 换成 the bathroom tap，说明另一个漏水位置。
把 Thursday between nine and eleven 换成 Friday between two and four，改约时段。
把 shuts off 换成 makes a loud noise，描述另一种空调表现。
responses: Does it happen every time?
说明间歇性故障并提供视频。
No, it does not happen every time. I have a video showing the problem.
We can start the repair now.
要求先确认报价。
Please do not start until I approve the quote.
The plumber will be late.
说明十二点要离开，请改约。
I need to leave at twelve. Could we arrange another time window?
practice.task: 报告一个家中故障，说明位置、频率和开始时间；问清检查费用和上门时段。模拟迟到或故障复发，协商下一步，不尝试自行处理电气或燃气危险。

quickReference.note: pipe under the sink 指水槽下的管道，和 tap 或 faucet 水龙头区分。
quickReference.exampleEn: The pipe under the sink keeps leaking.
quickReference.exampleZh: 水槽下面的管道一直漏水。

quickReference.note: leak 说明流出或渗漏；drip 更具体表示滴落，不是所有故障都用 leak。
quickReference.exampleEn: The pipe under the sink keeps leaking.
quickReference.exampleZh: 水槽下面的管道一直漏水。

quickReference.note: fee 是服务收费，是否包括检查、人工、配件需分别核对。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a call-out fee?
quickReference.exampleZh: 有上门费吗？

quickReference.note: window 在这里是预约时段，不是窗户；说明起止时间。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you give me a time window for the visit?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能告诉我上门的大致时间段吗？

quickReference.note: shuts off 描述停止运行，不自行推断故障原因。
quickReference.exampleEn: It works for a few minutes, then shuts off.
quickReference.exampleZh: 它运行几分钟后就停了。

quickReference.note: approve 是同意报价，收到报价或授权检查不等于授权维修。
quickReference.exampleEn: Please do not start the repair until I approve the quote.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我确认报价之前，请不要开始维修。

chapters.title: 付款失败与重复扣款
chapters.task: 核对交易 · 更换支付 · 查询扣款
chapters.example: The payment failed, but the money has left my account.
chapters.translation: 支付失败了，但账户里的钱已经扣了。
chapters.scenario: 商店刷卡显示失败，但银行 App 出现一笔待处理交易，你先请收银员核查再决定是否重试。另一段练习是账单出现两笔已入账的相同交易，向银行询问调查步骤；不提供密码、验证码或完整卡号。
phrases: a failed payment 失败的支付
a pending transaction 待处理交易
a declined card 被拒的银行卡
a duplicate charge 重复扣款
a bank statement 银行账单
a reference number 查询编号

lines.en: The payment failed, but the money has left my account.
lines.zh: 支付失败了，但账户里的钱已经扣了。
lines.note: 这是顾客对现象的描述；pending 交易可能尚未最终入账，需要核查，不能直接当作已完成扣款。

lines.en: Could you check whether the payment went through?
lines.zh: 能查一下支付是否成功了吗？

lines.en: It is showing as pending in my banking app.
lines.zh: 银行 App 里显示为待处理。

lines.en: I would like to check before trying again.
lines.zh: 我想先核对，再重新尝试。

lines.en: My card was declined.
lines.zh: 我的卡被拒了。

lines.en: Could I pay with a different card?
lines.zh: 我可以换一张卡付款吗？

lines.en: I think I have been charged twice.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己被扣了两次钱。
lines.note: have been charged twice 说明同一项消费疑似重复收费；先区分已入账交易和临时授权。

lines.en: Both transactions are on my statement.
lines.zh: 两笔交易都在我的账单上。

lines.en: The amount and the merchant are the same.
lines.zh: 金额和商户相同。

lines.en: What information do you need to investigate this?
lines.zh: 调查这件事需要哪些信息？

lines.en: Could you give me a reference number?
lines.zh: 能给我一个查询编号吗？
lines.note: reference number 用于后续查询，不是账户密码或验证码。

lines.en: When should I contact you again if this is not resolved?
lines.zh: 如果还没解决，我应该什么时候再次联系？

dialogues.title: 失败提示与待处理交易
dialogues.subtitle: 先核对商户记录，避免盲目重复支付

lines.en: The payment failed, but the money has left my account.
lines.zh: 支付失败了，但账户里的钱已经扣了。

lines.en: Let me check the terminal. What does your banking app show?
lines.zh: 让我查一下支付终端，你的银行 App 显示什么？

lines.en: It is showing as pending. Could you check whether the payment went through?
lines.zh: 显示为待处理，能查一下支付是否成功了吗？

lines.en: There is no completed payment in our record yet.
lines.zh: 我们的记录里暂时没有已完成的支付。

lines.en: I would like to check before trying again. Could I have a record of the failed attempt?
lines.zh: 我想先核对再重试，可以给我这次失败尝试的记录吗？

lines.en: Yes. You can use this record when contacting your bank.
lines.zh: 可以，联系银行时可以使用这份记录。

dialogues.title: 向银行查询重复扣款
dialogues.subtitle: 给出交易信息并确认后续查询方式

lines.en: I think I have been charged twice for the same purchase.
lines.zh: 同一笔消费我觉得被扣了两次钱。

lines.en: Are both transactions pending, or have they both posted?
lines.zh: 两笔都是待处理，还是都已入账？

lines.en: Both have posted. The amount and the merchant are the same.
lines.zh: 两笔都已入账，金额和商户相同。

lines.en: Please give us the dates and transaction references through our secure channel.
lines.zh: 请通过我们的安全渠道提供日期和交易编号。

lines.en: I will do that. Could you give me a reference number for this inquiry?
lines.zh: 我会提供，能给这次查询一个编号吗？

lines.en: Yes. We will confirm the investigation timeline after reviewing the records.
lines.zh: 可以，我们查看记录后会确认调查时间安排。

lines.en: When should I contact you again if this is not resolved?
lines.zh: 如果还没解决，我应该什么时候再联系？

lines.en: Use the date in our confirmation and quote the inquiry reference.
lines.zh: 请按我们确认信息里的日期联系，并提供查询编号。

branches.title: 银行卡被拒
branches.subtitle: 换支付方式，之后通过银行核查

lines.en: The terminal says your card was declined.
lines.zh: 终端显示你的卡被拒了。

lines.en: Could I pay with a different card?
lines.zh: 我可以换一张卡付款吗？

lines.en: Yes. This attempt did not complete on our terminal.
lines.zh: 可以，这次尝试在我们的终端上没有完成。

lines.en: Thanks. I will also check the first attempt with my bank.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我也会向银行核对第一次尝试。

branches.title: 现金找零不符
branches.subtitle: 核对付款金额与应找金额

lines.en: Sorry, I paid with a twenty-dollar note, but I received change for ten.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我付的是二十美元纸币，但找零按十美元算了。

lines.en: Let me check the payment and the cash drawer.
lines.zh: 让我核对付款和钱箱。

lines.en: Thank you. Here is my receipt.
lines.zh: 谢谢，这是我的小票。

lines.en: You are right. Here is the remaining ten dollars.
lines.zh: 你说得对，这是少找的十美元。

substitutions: 把 a different card 换成 cash，询问能否用现金付款。
把 twice 换成 three times，报告疑似三笔扣款。
把 the same merchant 换成 a merchant I do not recognize，说明无法识别的商户。
responses: What does your app show?
说明交易待处理。
It is showing as pending in my banking app.
Would you like to try again?
先核对上一笔是否成功。
Could you check whether the first payment went through before I try again?
Both transactions have posted.
询问调查需要的信息及查询编号。
What information do you need to investigate this? Could I have a reference number?
practice.task: 区分支付失败、待处理和已入账三种状态；说明疑似重复扣款的日期和金额，问清调查步骤与跟进时间。练习中不用真实账户信息。

quickReference.note: pending 不等于最终已入账，也不等于完全未扣款；请银行核查状态。
quickReference.exampleEn: It is showing as pending in my banking app.
quickReference.exampleZh: 银行 App 里显示为待处理。

quickReference.note: whether the payment went through 是核查交易是否完成，不只是页面是否关闭。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you check whether the payment went through?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能查一下支付是否成功了吗？

quickReference.note: card was declined 是卡支付被拒，原因要核查，不能猜成余额不足。
quickReference.exampleEn: My card was declined.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我的卡被拒了。

quickReference.note: 先确认两笔已入账，区别临时授权与重复实际收费。
quickReference.exampleEn: I think I have been charged twice.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我觉得自己被扣了两次钱。

quickReference.note: statement 汇总账户交易，receipt 通常是单次购买收据。
quickReference.exampleEn: Both transactions are on my statement.
quickReference.exampleZh: 两笔交易都在我的账单上。

quickReference.note: 后续跟进用 reference number，不提供验证码或账户密码。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you give me a reference number?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能给我一个查询编号吗？

chapters.title: 外卖点餐与订单问题
chapters.task: 说明地址 · 核对餐品 · 协商处理
chapters.example: One of the meals is missing from my order.
chapters.translation: 我的订单少了一份餐。
chapters.scenario: 你点了两份外卖，提前说明公寓入口与门牌。送到后发现少了一份，联系商家在补送与退款之间选择；食物和配送问题通过订单平台处理，不向陌生人透露门禁密码。
phrases: delivery instructions 配送说明
the side entrance 侧门入口
a missing meal 少送的一份餐
a replacement order 补送订单
estimated arrival time 预计到达时间
contact the restaurant 联系餐厅

lines.en: One of the meals is missing from my order.
lines.zh: 我的订单少了一份餐。
lines.note: one of 后用复数 meals，谓语用 is；具体说明缺的是哪一份。

lines.en: Please use the side entrance on Oak Street.
lines.zh: 请走 Oak Street 上的侧门。

lines.en: The apartment number is four B.
lines.zh: 门牌是 4B。

lines.en: Please call me when you arrive.
lines.zh: 到了请给我打电话。

lines.en: I can meet you at the entrance.
lines.zh: 我可以到入口接你。

lines.en: The delivery is later than the estimated time.
lines.zh: 配送已经晚于预计时间了。

lines.en: Could you check where the driver is?
lines.zh: 能查一下骑手到哪里了吗？

lines.en: The app says delivered, but I have not received it.
lines.zh: App 显示已送达，但我没收到。

lines.en: This is not what I ordered.
lines.zh: 这不是我点的。

lines.en: Could you send the missing meal?
lines.zh: 能把少送的那份餐送来吗？

lines.en: How long would a replacement take?
lines.zh: 补送要多久？
lines.note: replacement 在这里指替代或补送的餐；不要默认补送一定比退款更快。

lines.en: I would prefer a refund for the missing item.
lines.zh: 我更希望退还少送那份餐的费用。
lines.note: for the missing item 限定退款范围，不默认整单退款。

dialogues.title: 骑手找不到入口
dialogues.subtitle: 给出街道、门牌和碰面方式

lines.en: Hi, I am outside your building, but the main door is locked.
lines.zh: 你好，我在楼外，但正门锁了。

lines.en: Please use the side entrance on Oak Street.
lines.zh: 请走 Oak Street 上的侧门。

lines.en: Is that next to the small grocery store?
lines.zh: 是在那家小杂货店旁边吗？

lines.en: Yes. The apartment number is four B, but I can meet you at the entrance.
lines.zh: 是的，门牌是 4B，不过我可以到入口接你。

lines.en: Great. I will wait there with your order.
lines.zh: 好，我拿着你的订单在那里等。

lines.en: Thank you. I am coming downstairs now.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我现在下楼。

dialogues.title: 少送一份餐
dialogues.subtitle: 核对缺失商品，比较处理方式

lines.en: One of the meals is missing from my order. The vegetable noodles are not in the bag.
lines.zh: 我的订单少了一份餐，袋子里没有蔬菜面。

lines.en: Sorry about that. Could you give me the order reference?
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以提供订单编号吗？

lines.en: I will send it through the app. Could you send the missing meal?
lines.zh: 我会通过 App 发给你，能把少送的餐送来吗？

lines.en: We can offer a replacement or a refund for that item.
lines.zh: 我们可以补送，或退还那件商品的费用。

lines.en: How long would a replacement take?
lines.zh: 补送要多久？

lines.en: The restaurant estimates about forty minutes.
lines.zh: 餐厅估计大约四十分钟。

lines.en: I need to leave soon, so I would prefer a refund for the missing item.
lines.zh: 我很快要出门，所以更希望退还少送那份餐的费用。

lines.en: I will request that and send you the confirmation.
lines.zh: 我会申请，并发给你确认信息。

branches.title: 迟到并联系不上餐厅
branches.subtitle: 通过平台查询，不反复猜测时间

lines.en: The delivery is later than the estimated time, and I cannot reach the restaurant.
lines.zh: 配送晚于预计时间，而且我联系不上餐厅。

lines.en: Let me check the order status for you.
lines.zh: 我来帮你查订单状态。

lines.en: Could you check where the driver is and give me an updated estimate?
lines.zh: 能查一下骑手在哪，并给一个更新后的预计时间吗？

lines.en: I will contact the delivery team and message you when I have an update.
lines.zh: 我会联系配送团队，有更新后给你发消息。

branches.title: 显示送达但没有收到
branches.subtitle: 核对放置地点和交付记录

lines.en: The app says delivered, but I have not received it.
lines.zh: App 显示已送达，但我没收到。

lines.en: Have you checked the side entrance and the delivery photo?
lines.zh: 你看过侧门和配送照片了吗？

lines.en: Yes. The photo shows a different building. Could you check the delivery location?
lines.zh: 看过了，照片是另一栋楼，能核查配送位置吗？

lines.en: I will investigate that and confirm the available options with you.
lines.zh: 我会调查，并和你确认可用的处理方式。

substitutions: 把 the side entrance 换成 the main entrance，改配送入口。
把 vegetable noodles 换成 chicken rice，说明少送的餐。
把 forty minutes 换成 twenty minutes，比较能否等待。
responses: The door is locked.
提出下楼到入口碰面。
I can meet you at the entrance.
We can replace it or refund that item.
先问补送时间。
How long would a replacement take?
The order shows as delivered.
说明照片地点不符。
I have not received it. The delivery photo shows a different building.
practice.task: 提供清楚的配送位置，核对两份餐；遇到缺餐或错误送达时提供订单记录，问清补送时间及退款范围。

quickReference.note: 给出街道或明显标识；不要把 entrance 入口和 exit 出口混淆。
quickReference.exampleEn: Please use the side entrance on Oak Street.
quickReference.exampleZh: 请走 Oak Street 上的侧门。

quickReference.note: estimated 表示估计而不是保证；这里关键词按名词 estimate 的读音展示。
quickReference.exampleEn: The delivery is later than the estimated time.
quickReference.exampleZh: 配送已经晚于预计时间了。

quickReference.note: missing 说明缺失，wrong item 是送错，两种处理需要分别说明。
quickReference.exampleEn: One of the meals is missing from my order.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我的订单少了一份餐。

quickReference.note: 问清补送时间及具体内容，不默认补送会即时到达。
quickReference.exampleEn: How long would a replacement take?
quickReference.exampleZh: 补送要多久？

quickReference.note: 这里按名词 refund 标注；问明退款针对缺失餐品还是整单。
quickReference.exampleEn: I would prefer a refund for the missing item.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我更希望退还少送那份餐的费用。

quickReference.note: 系统状态不等于已亲自收到，未收到时核对照片和地点。
quickReference.exampleEn: The app says delivered, but I have not received it.
quickReference.exampleZh: App 显示已送达，但我没收到。

chapters.title: 去朋友家做客与招待客人
chapters.task: 做客准备 · 招待 · 自然告辞
chapters.example: Is there anything you would like me to bring?
chapters.translation: 你希望我带点什么吗？
chapters.scenario: 周六晚上去朋友家吃饭，事先问是否需要带东西，并告知自己不吃肉。另一段练习是招待朋友喝茶；要离开时明确告辞，面对挽留也可以温和坚持自己的时间安排。
phrases: bring something along 顺便带点东西
make yourself at home 别拘束
help yourself 请随意取用
take off your shoes 脱鞋
head home 回家
have an early start 明早要早起

lines.en: Is there anything you would like me to bring?
lines.zh: 你希望我带点什么吗？
lines.note: 这是出发前的礼貌询问；对方说不用带时可以接受，不必一再坚持。

lines.en: Thanks for inviting me over.
lines.zh: 谢谢邀请我到你家。

lines.en: Should I take my shoes off?
lines.zh: 我需要脱鞋吗？

lines.en: Make yourself at home.
lines.zh: 别拘束，就当在自己家。

lines.en: Would you like some tea or coffee?
lines.zh: 你想喝点茶还是咖啡？

lines.en: Tea would be lovely, thanks.
lines.zh: 喝茶就很好，谢谢。

lines.en: I do not eat meat, but the vegetables look great.
lines.zh: 我不吃肉，不过这些蔬菜看起来很棒。

lines.en: No more for me, thanks. I am full.
lines.zh: 我不再添了，谢谢，我吃饱了。

lines.en: Please help yourself to some fruit.
lines.zh: 请随意拿些水果吃。
lines.note: help yourself to ... 指自行取用食物或饮料，不是请客人自己解决困难。

lines.en: I should head home soon.
lines.zh: 我该准备回家了。
lines.note: head home 是往家走；home 前不加 to。明确结束比含糊暗示更方便主人回应。

lines.en: I have an early start tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我明天一早有安排。

lines.en: I had a lovely evening. Thank you for having me.
lines.zh: 今晚很开心，谢谢你招待我。

dialogues.title: 做客前确认准备
dialogues.subtitle: 询问时间、带什么及饮食偏好

lines.en: Thanks for inviting me over on Saturday. What time should I come?
lines.zh: 谢谢邀请我周六去你家，我几点到合适？

lines.en: Around six would be good. We will eat at six thirty.
lines.zh: 六点左右就好，我们六点半吃饭。

lines.en: Is there anything you would like me to bring?
lines.zh: 你希望我带点什么吗？

lines.en: No need. I have everything ready. Do you have any dietary preferences?
lines.zh: 不用，我都准备好了。你有饮食偏好吗？

lines.en: I do not eat meat. Would that be a problem?
lines.zh: 我不吃肉，会不会不方便？

lines.en: Not at all. I will make a vegetable dish we can share.
lines.zh: 不会，我会做一道大家都可以吃的蔬菜菜肴。

dialogues.title: 进门与招待饮品
dialogues.subtitle: 尊重家中习惯，自然接受招待

lines.en: Come in! It is good to see you.
lines.zh: 进来吧，很高兴见到你。

lines.en: Good to see you too. Should I take my shoes off?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴见到你，需要脱鞋吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. There are slippers by the door. Make yourself at home.
lines.zh: 需要，谢谢。门旁有拖鞋，别拘束。

lines.en: Thanks. Your place is lovely.
lines.zh: 谢谢，你家真漂亮。

lines.en: Would you like some tea or coffee?
lines.zh: 你想喝茶还是咖啡？

lines.en: Tea would be lovely, thanks.
lines.zh: 喝茶就很好，谢谢。

lines.en: Of course. Please help yourself to some fruit while I make it.
lines.zh: 当然，我泡茶时你可以随意拿些水果。

lines.en: Thank you. That is very kind.
lines.zh: 谢谢，你真周到。

branches.title: 主人不断添菜
branches.subtitle: 表达感谢，也清楚表示已经吃饱

lines.en: Would you like another serving?
lines.zh: 要不要再添一份？

lines.en: No more for me, thanks. I am full.
lines.zh: 我不再添了，谢谢，我吃饱了。

lines.en: Are you sure? There is plenty left.
lines.zh: 确定吗，还有很多呢。

lines.en: Yes, thank you. I really enjoyed it, but I cannot eat any more.
lines.zh: 确定，谢谢，我吃得很开心，不过确实吃不下了。

branches.title: 需要离开但对方挽留
branches.subtitle: 不勉强答应，再约下一次

lines.en: I should head home soon. I have an early start tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我该回家了，明天一早有安排。

lines.en: Stay a little longer. We could watch a film.
lines.zh: 再待一会儿吧，我们可以看电影。

lines.en: I would love to stay longer another time, but I need to leave now. Thank you for having me.
lines.zh: 改天我很愿意多待一会儿，不过现在得走了，谢谢你招待我。

lines.en: Of course. Let us plan something for next weekend.
lines.zh: 当然，我们再约下周末吧。

substitutions: 把 tea 换成 water，接受不同饮品。
把 take my shoes off 换成 leave my coat here，询问外套放置。
把 an early start tomorrow 换成 a train to catch，说明离开原因。
responses: Would you like more food?
礼貌说明吃饱了。
No more for me, thanks. I am full.
What time should I come?
邀请对方六点到，六点半吃饭。
Around six would be good. We will eat at six thirty.
Stay a little longer.
感谢招待，但坚持现在离开。
Thank you for having me, but I need to leave now. Let us do this again soon.
practice.task: 分别扮演主人和客人，完成邀请准备、进门问候、提供饮品和告辞；练习不吃某种食物与拒绝添菜，不为礼貌而承诺自己做不到的安排。

quickReference.note: over 在这里表示到自己所在处，不是所有邀请都发生在家里。
quickReference.exampleEn: Thanks for inviting me over.
quickReference.exampleZh: 谢谢邀请我到你家。

quickReference.note: 这是招待客人的惯用表达，不代表可以忽略主人的家中习惯。
quickReference.exampleEn: Make yourself at home.
quickReference.exampleZh: 别拘束，就当在自己家。

quickReference.note: 常搭配 to some fruit 或 to a drink；仍尊重主人提供的范围。
quickReference.exampleEn: Please help yourself to some fruit.
quickReference.exampleZh: 请随意拿些水果吃。

quickReference.note: I am full 表示吃饱，I am filled 不适合作为同样的日常回应。
quickReference.exampleEn: No more for me, thanks. I am full.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我不再添了，谢谢，我吃饱了。

quickReference.note: head 作动词指前往；home 是方向副词，通常不加 to。
quickReference.exampleEn: I should head home soon.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我该准备回家了。

quickReference.note: 解释要走的时间限制，不必为告辞编造细节。
quickReference.exampleEn: I have an early start tomorrow.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我明天一早有安排。

chapters.title: 邻里沟通与共同空间
chapters.task: 说明影响 · 提出请求 · 协调安排
chapters.example: Would you mind keeping the music down after ten?
chapters.translation: 十点以后能把音乐声音调小一些吗？
chapters.scenario: 邻居晚间音乐较响，你在平静时说明对睡眠的影响并提出十点后调低音量的请求。另练习共用走廊堆放物品和临时使用装卸区域；反复出现或不便直接沟通时联系物业。
phrases: keep the music down 调低音乐声
come through the wall 从墙那边传来
a shared hallway 共用走廊
leave enough room 留出足够空间
a loading area 装卸区域
building management 物业管理

lines.en: Would you mind keeping the music down after ten?
lines.zh: 十点以后能把音乐声音调小一些吗？
lines.note: Would you mind 后接 doing；同意时可说 Of course 或 Not at all，避免只用含糊的 yes。

lines.en: The sound comes through the wall into my bedroom.
lines.zh: 声音会穿过墙传进我的卧室。

lines.en: I have to get up early for work.
lines.zh: 我上班需要早起。

lines.en: Thanks for understanding.
lines.zh: 谢谢你理解。

lines.en: Could we agree on a quieter time in the evening?
lines.zh: 能商量一下晚间保持安静的时间吗？
lines.note: agree on a time 是共同商定时间；说清希望的时段，也听取对方能做到的安排。

lines.en: These boxes are blocking the shared hallway.
lines.zh: 这些箱子挡住了共用走廊。

lines.en: Could you move them so there is enough room to pass?
lines.zh: 能挪一下，让大家有足够空间通过吗？

lines.en: I will move them this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我今天下午会挪走。

lines.en: Is this space reserved for loading?
lines.zh: 这个位置是专门用来装卸的吗？

lines.en: How long will you need the space?
lines.zh: 你还需要占用这个位置多久？

lines.en: The same issue happened again last night.
lines.zh: 昨晚同样的问题又出现了。

lines.en: Could building management help us resolve this?
lines.zh: 物业能帮我们协调解决吗？
lines.note: resolve this 指解决具体问题；报告时间和影响，避免替对方断定动机。

dialogues.title: 说明晚间噪声影响
dialogues.subtitle: 谈具体问题，提出可执行请求

lines.en: Hi. Could I ask you about the music in the evening?
lines.zh: 你好，我能和你说说晚间音乐的事吗？

lines.en: Of course. Is it too loud?
lines.zh: 当然，是太响了吗？

lines.en: The sound comes through the wall into my bedroom. I have to get up early for work.
lines.zh: 声音会穿过墙传进卧室，我上班需要早起。

lines.en: I did not realize you could hear it so clearly.
lines.zh: 我不知道你那边听得这么清楚。

lines.en: Would you mind keeping the music down after ten?
lines.zh: 十点以后能把音乐声音调小一些吗？

lines.en: Of course. I can use headphones later in the evening.
lines.zh: 可以，晚上晚些时候我可以戴耳机。

lines.en: Thanks for understanding.
lines.zh: 谢谢你理解。

lines.en: No problem. Thanks for letting me know.
lines.zh: 没关系，谢谢告诉我。

dialogues.title: 清理共用走廊
dialogues.subtitle: 询问物品归属并确认处理时间

lines.en: Are these boxes yours? They are blocking the shared hallway.
lines.zh: 这些箱子是你的吗？它们挡住了共用走廊。

lines.en: Yes. I left them there while unpacking.
lines.zh: 是的，我拆箱整理时暂时放在那儿。

lines.en: Could you move them so there is enough room to pass?
lines.zh: 能挪一下，让大家有足够空间通过吗？

lines.en: Sorry. I will move them this afternoon.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我今天下午会挪走。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you clear a path now? Someone is coming through with a stroller.
lines.zh: 谢谢，能现在先让出一条路吗？有人要推婴儿车经过。

lines.en: Of course. I will move these two boxes inside now.
lines.zh: 当然，我现在先把这两个箱子搬进屋。

branches.title: 双方需要不同
branches.subtitle: 商量时间，不强迫对方接受单一安排

lines.en: I practice music in the evening because I work during the day.
lines.zh: 我白天工作，所以晚上练琴。

lines.en: I understand. Could we agree on a quieter time after ten?
lines.zh: 我理解，能约定十点以后安静一些吗？

lines.en: I can finish by nine thirty on weekdays.
lines.zh: 工作日我可以九点半之前结束。

lines.en: That would help. Let us try that and check in next week.
lines.zh: 那会有帮助，我们先试试，下周再沟通。

branches.title: 噪声反复出现
branches.subtitle: 让物业协调，提供具体记录

lines.en: The same issue happened again last night. Could building management help us resolve this?
lines.zh: 昨晚同样的问题又出现了，物业能帮我们协调吗？

lines.en: Can you tell us the time and what you could hear?
lines.zh: 能告诉我们时间及听到的声音吗？

lines.en: Loud music between eleven and midnight. We had previously discussed keeping it down after ten.
lines.zh: 十一点到午夜有很响的音乐，我们之前谈过十点后调低音量。

lines.en: We will review the building rules and contact the resident about the issue.
lines.zh: 我们会核对楼内规定，并联系住户沟通此事。

substitutions: 把 music 换成 television，说明电视声音问题。
把 boxes 换成 bicycles，讨论走廊放置。
把 after ten 换成 after nine thirty，协商不同时间。
responses: I did not realize it was loud.
说明声音传进卧室，提出具体时段。
The sound comes through the wall into my bedroom. Could you keep it down after ten?
I will move them later.
请对方现在先留出通道。
Could you clear a path now so there is enough room to pass?
What time did it happen?
报告昨晚十一点至午夜。
It happened last night between eleven and midnight.
practice.task: 先用一句说明可观察的问题，再说影响和具体请求；对方有不同安排时协商。问题再次发生或直接沟通不安全时，转向物业求助。

quickReference.note: 后接动词 ing；答应请求可说 Of course 或 Not at all，避免仅用 yes 引起歧义。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you mind keeping the music down after ten?
quickReference.exampleZh: 十点以后能把音乐声音调小一些吗？

quickReference.note: down 表示调低，turn it off 是关掉，要求不同。
quickReference.exampleEn: Would you mind keeping the music down after ten?
quickReference.exampleZh: 十点以后能把音乐声音调小一些吗？

quickReference.note: shared 表明多人使用；留出通道的请求要说具体受影响位置。
quickReference.exampleEn: These boxes are blocking the shared hallway.
quickReference.exampleZh: 这些箱子挡住了共用走廊。

quickReference.note: boxes are blocking the hallway 描述事实，比一开始责备对方更便于协调。
quickReference.exampleEn: These boxes are blocking the shared hallway.
quickReference.exampleZh: 这些箱子挡住了共用走廊。

quickReference.note: agree on a time 是商定时间；agree with someone 是赞同某人。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could we agree on a quieter time in the evening?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能商量一下晚间保持安静的时间吗？

quickReference.note: 给物业具体时间和现象；issue 在这里是问题，不是发行。
quickReference.exampleEn: The same issue happened again last night.
quickReference.exampleZh: 昨晚同样的问题又出现了。

chapters.title: 订阅、自动续费与取消服务
chapters.task: 确认续费 · 取消服务 · 核对账单
chapters.example: Could you confirm that I will not be charged again?
chapters.translation: 能确认不会再向我收费吗？
chapters.scenario: 你的线上服务试用期即将结束，先核对自动续费日期与取消方式。另一段练习是已经收到取消确认后又出现收费，提供记录请客服核查；是否退款、何时停止使用以该服务的条款和书面回复为准。
phrases: a free trial 免费试用
automatic renewal 自动续费
a billing date 扣费日期
cancel a subscription 取消订阅
a cancellation confirmation 取消确认
an additional charge 额外收费

lines.en: Could you confirm that I will not be charged again?
lines.zh: 能确认不会再向我收费吗？
lines.note: 确认未来收费应明确日期和订阅范围，不把取消按钮等同于所有待结账款项都消失。

lines.en: When does my free trial end?
lines.zh: 我的免费试用什么时候结束？

lines.en: Does the subscription renew automatically?
lines.zh: 订阅会自动续费吗？

lines.en: What is the next billing date?
lines.zh: 下次扣费日期是什么时候？

lines.en: I would like to cancel my subscription.
lines.zh: 我想取消订阅。

lines.en: Will I still have access until the end of this month?
lines.zh: 到本月底之前我还能继续使用吗？

lines.en: Does this offer start a new commitment period?
lines.zh: 这个优惠会开始一个新的承诺期限吗？
lines.note: commitment period 指需要承担义务的期限；是否能随时取消，要确认具体条款。

lines.en: Please send me written confirmation of the cancellation.
lines.zh: 请发给我书面的取消确认。

lines.en: I cannot find the subscription in my account.
lines.zh: 我在账户里找不到这个订阅。

lines.en: The subscription may be under a different account.
lines.zh: 这个订阅可能在另一个账户下。

lines.en: I was charged after receiving the cancellation confirmation.
lines.zh: 收到取消确认后，我又被收费了。

lines.en: Could you check what this charge is for?
lines.zh: 能核查这笔费用是什么吗？
lines.note: what ... is for 询问收费缘由，先核实费用归属，再讨论退款。

dialogues.title: 试用结束前取消
dialogues.subtitle: 确认续费日期和停止访问时间

lines.en: When does my free trial end, and does the subscription renew automatically?
lines.zh: 我的免费试用什么时候结束，订阅会自动续费吗？

lines.en: Your trial ends on November fifth. This plan renews automatically the next day.
lines.zh: 你的试用十一月五日结束，这个方案次日自动续费。

lines.en: I would like to cancel my subscription before the next billing date.
lines.zh: 我想在下次扣费日期之前取消订阅。

lines.en: I can cancel the renewal. Your trial access will continue until November fifth.
lines.zh: 我可以取消续费，试用权限保留到十一月五日。

lines.en: Could you confirm that I will not be charged again for this plan?
lines.zh: 能确认这个方案不会再向我收费吗？

lines.en: Yes. I will send you written confirmation showing the cancellation date.
lines.zh: 可以，我会发送写明取消日期的书面确认。

dialogues.title: 取消后又收到收费
dialogues.subtitle: 提供确认记录，问清费用归属

lines.en: I was charged after receiving the cancellation confirmation.
lines.zh: 收到取消确认后，我又被收费了。

lines.en: Could you share the confirmation and the charge date through your account?
lines.zh: 能通过账户提供确认信息和扣费日期吗？

lines.en: Yes. Could you check what this charge is for?
lines.zh: 可以，能核查这笔费用是什么吗？

lines.en: I will check whether it belongs to this subscription or another service.
lines.zh: 我会查是这个订阅的费用还是另一项服务的费用。

lines.en: Please let me know the result and whether a refund is available.
lines.zh: 请告诉我核查结果，以及是否可以退款。

lines.en: I will send the result and the applicable refund terms after reviewing the records.
lines.zh: 查看记录后，我会发送结果和适用的退款条款。

branches.title: 优惠附带新的期限
branches.subtitle: 先问条件，不立即接受挽留

lines.en: We could offer you a lower monthly price if you stay.
lines.zh: 如果保留订阅，我们可以提供更低月费。

lines.en: Does this offer start a new commitment period?
lines.zh: 这个优惠会开始一个新的承诺期限吗？

lines.en: It would require a six-month commitment.
lines.zh: 它要求承诺使用六个月。

lines.en: Thanks, but I do not want a new commitment. Please continue with the cancellation.
lines.zh: 谢谢，但我不想承担新的期限，请继续取消。

branches.title: 账户找不到订阅
branches.subtitle: 核对购买渠道，避免重复创建

lines.en: I cannot find the subscription in my account.
lines.zh: 我在账户里找不到这个订阅。

lines.en: Did you subscribe through our website or an app store?
lines.zh: 你是在我们网站还是应用商店订阅的？

lines.en: Through an app store. I still have the purchase receipt.
lines.zh: 通过应用商店，我还留着购买收据。

lines.en: Please check that store’s subscription settings using the account shown on the receipt.
lines.zh: 请使用收据对应的账户，在那家商店的订阅设置里查询。

substitutions: 把 free trial 换成 monthly plan，询问月度方案。
把 November fifth 换成 December first，核对停止使用日期。
把 a six-month commitment 换成 a one-year commitment，比较承诺期限。
responses: We can offer a lower price.
先问是否增加新的承诺期限。
Does this offer start a new commitment period?
I have cancelled the renewal.
要求书面取消确认。
Please send me written confirmation of the cancellation.
Where did you subscribe?
说明通过应用商店，并有收据。
Through an app store. I still have the purchase receipt.
practice.task: 核对试用结束与续费日期，取消订阅并确认停止访问时间；模拟取消后扣费，提供记录并询问费用归属和处理条件。

quickReference.note: 免费试用可能接自动续费，问清截止日期和取消方式。
quickReference.exampleEn: When does my free trial end?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我的免费试用什么时候结束？

quickReference.note: renew 不必一定免费；核对续费价格、周期和日期。
quickReference.exampleEn: Does the subscription renew automatically?
quickReference.exampleZh: 订阅会自动续费吗？

quickReference.note: 扣费日期与停止访问日期可能不同，分开确认。
quickReference.exampleEn: What is the next billing date?
quickReference.exampleZh: 下次扣费日期是什么时候？

quickReference.note: 删除 App 不等于取消订阅；确认购买渠道和取消结果。
quickReference.exampleEn: I would like to cancel my subscription.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我想取消订阅。

quickReference.note: 低价优惠可能带新期限，接受前核对取消条件。
quickReference.exampleEn: Does this offer start a new commitment period?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这个优惠会开始一个新的承诺期限吗？

quickReference.note: 保存写明取消日期和订阅范围的确认，用于收费核查。
quickReference.exampleEn: Please send me written confirmation of the cancellation.
quickReference.exampleZh: 请发给我书面的取消确认。

chapters.title: 和刚认识的人互相了解
chapters.task: 介绍自己 · 顺着话题聊 · 尊重边界
chapters.example: What do you enjoy doing outside work?
chapters.translation: 工作之外你喜欢做些什么？
chapters.scenario: 你在朋友组织的周末散步活动中第一次见到 Jamie。先介绍名字和参加活动的缘由，聊平时喜欢做的事；之后用对方说过的信息继续话题，主动分享自己的经历。活动地点使用虚构设定，不追问收入、住址或不愿分享的经历。
phrases: nice to meet you 很高兴认识你
outside work 工作之外
get into a hobby 开始喜欢某项爱好
How about you? 你呢
have something in common 有共同之处
keep in touch 保持联系

lines.en: What do you enjoy doing outside work?
lines.zh: 工作之外你喜欢做些什么？
lines.note: outside work 把话题从工作移到个人兴趣；对方不工作时可以直接问 What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

lines.en: Hi, I am Alex. I do not think we have met.
lines.zh: 你好，我叫 Alex，我们应该还没见过。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. How do you know Sam?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你，你是怎么认识 Sam 的？

lines.en: Is this your first time joining the group?
lines.zh: 这是你第一次参加这个小组的活动吗？

lines.en: Have you lived in this city for long?
lines.zh: 你在这座城市住了很久吗？
lines.note: for long 问时长；不等同于问国籍或具体住址。对方简短回答时不要反复追问来源。

lines.en: I moved here about six months ago.
lines.zh: 我大约六个月前搬来这里。

lines.en: I have been getting into photography lately.
lines.zh: 我最近开始喜欢上摄影了。
lines.note: get into 在此指逐渐对某事感兴趣，不是进入某个地方；lately 表示最近一段时间。

lines.en: How did you get into that?
lines.zh: 你是怎么开始喜欢上这个的？

lines.en: I enjoy taking photos too, especially when I travel.
lines.zh: 我也喜欢拍照，尤其是旅行的时候。

lines.en: You mentioned hiking. Do you have a favorite local trail?
lines.zh: 你刚才提到徒步，你有喜欢的本地路线吗？

lines.en: I would rather keep that private, but I am happy to talk about my hobbies.
lines.zh: 那件事我想保留不说，不过我很愿意聊聊爱好。

lines.en: Would you like to keep in touch?
lines.zh: 你愿意以后保持联系吗？
lines.note: 询问对方意愿，接受拒绝或只在活动中见面的选择；不默认索要电话号码。

dialogues.title: 从共同活动开始认识
dialogues.subtitle: 相互介绍，不连续抛出一串问题

lines.en: Hi, I am Alex. I do not think we have met.
lines.zh: 你好，我叫 Alex，我们应该还没见过。

lines.en: I am Jamie. Nice to meet you. Is this your first time joining the group?
lines.zh: 我叫 Jamie，很高兴认识你。你第一次参加这个小组的活动吗？

lines.en: Yes. Sam invited me. How do you know Sam?
lines.zh: 是的，Sam 邀请我来的，你是怎么认识 Sam 的？

lines.en: We met at a photography class. Have you lived in this city for long?
lines.zh: 我们在摄影课上认识的，你在这座城市住了很久吗？

lines.en: About a year. I am still finding places to explore. How about you?
lines.zh: 大约一年，我还在找值得逛的地方。你呢？

lines.en: I moved here about six months ago. These walks have helped me meet people.
lines.zh: 我大约六个月前搬来，这些散步活动帮我认识了一些人。

lines.en: That is partly why I came too. It is nice to explore with a group.
lines.zh: 我来也是出于这个原因，和一群人一起探索很不错。

lines.en: Exactly. It is easier to start a conversation while walking.
lines.zh: 是啊，边走边聊更容易打开话题。

dialogues.title: 顺着兴趣深入一点
dialogues.subtitle: 听对方说过什么，也分享自己的经历

lines.en: What do you enjoy doing outside work?
lines.zh: 工作之外你喜欢做些什么？

lines.en: I have been getting into photography lately. I also like hiking.
lines.zh: 我最近开始喜欢摄影，也喜欢徒步。

lines.en: I enjoy taking photos too, especially when I travel. How did you get into that?
lines.zh: 我也喜欢拍照，尤其是旅行的时候，你是怎么开始喜欢摄影的？

lines.en: A friend lent me a camera, and I started taking pictures on our walks.
lines.zh: 一个朋友借给我相机，我开始在散步时拍照。

lines.en: That sounds fun. You mentioned hiking. Do you have a favorite local trail?
lines.zh: 听起来很有意思，你刚才提到徒步，有喜欢的本地路线吗？

lines.en: The riverside trail is a good easy walk. What kinds of trips do you enjoy?
lines.zh: 河边那条路线很好走，你喜欢什么样的旅行？

lines.en: Mostly short trips with time to walk around. I like noticing the small details.
lines.zh: 主要是有时间到处走走的短途旅行，我喜欢留意小细节。

lines.en: Same here. We could compare photos after the walk.
lines.zh: 我也是，我们散步后可以互相看看照片。

branches.title: 话题涉及不想说的私事
branches.subtitle: 接受边界，顺势换话题

lines.en: What made you decide to move here?
lines.zh: 是什么让你决定搬来这里？

lines.en: I would rather keep that private, but I am happy to talk about my hobbies.
lines.zh: 那件事我想保留不说，不过我很愿意聊聊爱好。

lines.en: Of course. No need to explain. Have you found any good places to take photos?
lines.zh: 当然，不用解释，你找到什么适合拍照的地方了吗？

lines.en: Yes, the old market is interesting, especially early in the morning.
lines.zh: 有，老市场很有意思，特别是清晨。

branches.title: 对方不想交换联系方式
branches.subtitle: 表达意愿后接受对方的选择

lines.en: I enjoyed talking with you. Would you like to keep in touch?
lines.zh: 和你聊天很开心，你愿意以后保持联系吗？

lines.en: It was nice talking to you too. I would prefer to just meet at the group walks for now.
lines.zh: 我也聊得很开心，不过目前我更希望只在小组散步时见面。

lines.en: Of course. Maybe I will see you at the next one.
lines.zh: 当然，也许下次活动还能见到你。

lines.en: I hope so. Enjoy the rest of your weekend.
