lines.en: Is there anything urgent I should finish first?
lines.zh: 有什么急事需要我先完成吗？

lines.en: Could you cover the inbox while I am away?
lines.zh: 我不在时，你能帮忙看一下收件箱吗？

lines.en: I'll send a handover note before I leave.
lines.zh: 我离开前会发交接说明。

lines.en: The draft is ready, but approval is still pending.
lines.zh: 草稿已准备好，但还在等批准。
lines.note: pending 指尚未决定或处理完；ready 的草稿不等于已经可以发布。

lines.en: The deadline is Wednesday at noon.
lines.zh: 截止时间是周三中午十二点。

lines.en: Please contact Sam for urgent issues.
lines.zh: 紧急问题请联系 Sam。

lines.en: I'll be back on Tuesday afternoon.
lines.zh: 我周二下午回来。

lines.en: Thanks for covering for me.
lines.zh: 谢谢你帮我代班。
lines.note: cover for 指代为处理工作；要先确认对方同意和职责范围。

dialogues.title: 申请半天假
dialogues.subtitle: 说明时间并先安排工作

lines.en: I'd like to request Tuesday morning off for an appointment.
lines.zh: 我想申请周二上午请假，有个预约。

lines.en: Have you checked the team schedule?
lines.zh: 你看过团队安排了吗？

lines.en: Yes. No meetings are scheduled then. Is there anything urgent I should finish first?
lines.zh: 看过，那个时段没安排会议，有什么急事要我先完成吗？

lines.en: Please finish the handover on Monday and submit the request in the system.
lines.zh: 请周一完成交接，并在系统提交申请。

lines.en: Of course. I'll be back on Tuesday afternoon.
lines.zh: 当然，我周二下午回来。

lines.en: Okay. I'll review the request once you submit it.
lines.zh: 好，你提交后我会审核。

dialogues.title: 交接进行中的任务
dialogues.subtitle: 状态、时间和联系人

lines.en: Could you cover the inbox on Tuesday morning?
lines.zh: 周二上午能帮我看一下收件箱吗？

lines.en: Sure. Is there anything I should watch for?
lines.zh: 可以，有什么要留意的吗？

lines.en: The draft is ready, but approval is pending. The deadline is Wednesday at noon.
lines.zh: 草稿好了，但还在等批准，截止时间是周三中午十二点。

lines.en: Who should I contact if there is an urgent question?
lines.zh: 有紧急问题时联系谁？

lines.en: Sam. I'll include the link, status, and contact in the handover note.
lines.zh: Sam，我会在交接说明里写链接、状态和联系人。

lines.en: Great. I'll check the inbox and message you when you're back.
lines.zh: 好，我会看收件箱，等你回来再发消息同步。

branches.title: 交接时间冲突
branches.subtitle: 提出另一个可行时间

lines.en: I have a meeting at two on Monday.
lines.zh: 周一两点我有会议。

lines.en: Would three thirty work for a fifteen-minute handover?
lines.zh: 三点半交接十五分钟可以吗？

lines.en: Yes, that works.
lines.zh: 可以。

lines.en: Thanks. I'll send the notes beforehand.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我会提前发说明。

branches.title: 请假时段团队人手不足
branches.subtitle: 协商安排但不默认获批

lines.en: We already have two people away on Tuesday morning.
lines.zh: 周二上午已经有两个人不在岗。

lines.en: Would taking Wednesday morning off be easier to arrange?
lines.zh: 改请周三上午是否更好安排？

lines.en: Possibly. Let me check the coverage first.
lines.zh: 可能，我先查一下人员安排。

lines.en: Thanks. I'll wait for confirmation before changing the request.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我会等确认后再改申请。

substitutions: 把 Tuesday morning 换成 Friday afternoon，申请另一时段。
把 inbox 换成 support queue，商量代看支持工单。
把 Wednesday at noon 换成 Thursday at four p.m.，说清交接期限。
responses: What time works for you?
提出周一三点半。
Would three thirty on Monday work?
Who handles urgent issues?
给联系人。
Please contact Sam for urgent issues.
I can cover the inbox.
感谢并承诺交接说明。
Thanks. I'll send a handover note beforehand.
practice.task: 申请一个明确时段的假期，协商交接时间；把未完成事项、截止时间和联系人说明清楚。

quickReference.note: 名词可说 a handover note；动词是 hand over，交代事项、状态和负责人。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'll send a handover note before I leave.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我离开前会发交接说明。

quickReference.note: 给可选时间段时明确日期和时区，works for you 指安排适合。
quickReference.exampleEn: What time works for you?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你什么时间方便？

quickReference.note: 工作场景的 leave 可作不可数名词；leave the office 则是离开办公室。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'll send a handover note before I leave.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我离开前会发交接说明。

quickReference.note: cover for someone 指临时代为承担工作，需要确认具体职责和时间。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you cover the inbox while I am away?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我不在时，你能帮忙看一下收件箱吗？

quickReference.note: 医疗预约、私人约定等均可用，工作消息不必主动展开私人细节。
quickReference.exampleEn: I'd like to request Tuesday morning off for an appointment.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我想申请周二上午请假，有个预约。

quickReference.note: approval is still pending 表示尚待批准；不等于申请已经被拒绝。
quickReference.exampleEn: The draft is ready, but approval is still pending.
quickReference.exampleZh: 草稿已准备好，但还在等批准。

chapters.title: 与客户确认需求和范围
chapters.task: 问清交付 · 核对范围 · 评估变更
chapters.example: What would a successful result look like for you?
chapters.translation: 对你来说，什么样的结果算成功？
chapters.scenario: 客户希望“尽快做一个简单报表”，你问清使用者、必要字段和成功标准。客户随后追加导出功能时，先评估范围与时间影响，再确认书面方案，不默默接受所有新增要求。
phrases: success criteria 成功标准
a must-have feature 必备功能
the agreed scope 已约定范围
an additional request 新增要求
a revised estimate 更新后的估算
written approval 书面确认

lines.en: What would a successful result look like for you?
lines.zh: 对你来说，什么样的结果算成功？
lines.note: 把笼统评价问成可观察的结果，便于双方确认是否达到目标。

lines.en: Who will be using this report?
lines.zh: 谁会使用这份报表？

lines.en: Which fields are essential for the first version?
lines.zh: 第一版必须包含哪些字段？

lines.en: Could you give me an example of what you need?
lines.zh: 能给我一个你需要的例子吗？

lines.en: When you say soon, do you have a specific date in mind?
lines.zh: 你说尽快，是有具体日期吗？

lines.en: Let me summarize what we have agreed.
lines.zh: 我总结一下我们已经达成的共识。

lines.en: The export feature is outside the current scope.
lines.zh: 导出功能不在当前约定范围内。
lines.note: outside the scope 说明范围差异；接着提供评估或取舍方案，不只拒绝。

lines.en: We can review the impact on the timeline and cost.
lines.zh: 我们可以评估对时间和费用的影响。

lines.en: Would you prefer to add this now or in a later phase?
lines.zh: 你希望现在加入，还是后续阶段再做？

lines.en: If we add this, we will need to revise the estimate.
lines.zh: 如果加入这一项，我们需要更新估算。

lines.en: Could you confirm the priorities in writing?
lines.zh: 能以书面方式确认优先级吗？

lines.en: We will start once the revised scope is approved.
lines.zh: 更新后的范围获确认后，我们再开始。
lines.note: once 指条件达成后；不要把尚未确认的估算说成确定承诺。

dialogues.title: 把模糊需求问具体
dialogues.subtitle: 明确用户、字段和交付日期

lines.en: We need a simple sales report as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 我们需要尽快做一个简单销售报表。

lines.en: Who will be using this report, and what would a successful result look like for you?
lines.zh: 谁会使用它，对你来说什么结果算成功？

lines.en: Our team leads need to compare weekly sales by region.
lines.zh: 团队负责人需要比较各区域的每周销售额。

lines.en: Which fields are essential for the first version?
lines.zh: 第一版必须包含哪些字段？

lines.en: Region, week and total sales. A chart would be useful, but it is not essential.
lines.zh: 区域、周和总销售额，有图表会有帮助，但不是必须。

lines.en: When you say soon, do you have a specific date in mind?
lines.zh: 你说尽快，是有具体日期吗？

lines.en: We would like to review a first version on Friday.
lines.zh: 我们希望周五评审第一版。

lines.en: I will check feasibility and send you the proposed scope and schedule today.
lines.zh: 我会核查可行性，今天发送拟定范围和时间安排。

dialogues.title: 新增功能需要取舍
dialogues.subtitle: 评估影响，再确认是否纳入

lines.en: Could you also add an export button? It should be a small change.
lines.zh: 也加个导出按钮好吗，应该只是小改动。

lines.en: The export feature is outside the current scope. We can review the impact on the timeline and cost.
lines.zh: 导出不在当前约定范围内，我们可以评估对时间和费用的影响。

lines.en: What would that involve?
lines.zh: 需要做哪些事情？

lines.en: We need to confirm the file format, fields and access rules before estimating.
lines.zh: 估算前要确认文件格式、字段和访问规则。

lines.en: Can we keep Friday for the report and add export later?
lines.zh: 报表仍按周五评审，导出以后再加可以吗？

lines.en: That is an option. I will send the revised plan for your approval.
lines.zh: 这是一个选项，我会发更新后的计划请你确认。

branches.title: 需求只说简单一点
branches.subtitle: 请对方给例子，核对具体变化

lines.en: Could you make the page simpler?
lines.zh: 能把页面做得简单一点吗？

lines.en: Could you give me an example of what feels complicated?
lines.zh: 能举一个让你觉得复杂的地方吗？

lines.en: There are too many filters. We only use region and week.
lines.zh: 筛选项太多了，我们只用区域和周。

lines.en: Understood. I will propose showing those first and review the other filters with you.
lines.zh: 明白，我会建议优先显示这两项，再和你核对其他筛选。

branches.title: 时间与范围无法同时满足
branches.subtitle: 提供明确取舍，由客户确认

lines.en: We need the report and export by Friday.
lines.zh: 我们周五前既要报表又要导出。

lines.en: We cannot confirm both for Friday yet. We can prioritize the report or revise the delivery date.
lines.zh: 目前不能确认两项都在周五完成，可以优先报表，或调整交付日期。

lines.en: The report is the priority. Please estimate export separately.
lines.zh: 报表优先，导出请单独估算。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you confirm those priorities in writing?
lines.zh: 谢谢，能书面确认这些优先级吗？

substitutions: 把 sales report 换成 customer dashboard，确认客户看板需求。
把 Friday 换成 next Wednesday，问清日期。
把 export feature 换成 email notifications，评估新增功能。
responses: We need it soon.
询问具体日期。
When you say soon, do you have a specific date in mind?
Just add one more feature.
说明需评估对范围和时间的影响。
We can review the impact on the scope and timeline before confirming.
The report is more important.
请求书面确认优先级。
Could you confirm that priority in writing?
practice.task: 将一个模糊需求问成用户、必备内容、成功标准和日期；遇到新增功能时给出取舍，确认书面范围后再承诺交付。

quickReference.note: 用可观察的标准解释成功，不只说 good 或 simple。
quickReference.exampleEn: What would a successful result look like for you?
quickReference.exampleZh: 对你来说，什么样的结果算成功？

quickReference.note: essential 与 useful 不同，先区分必备功能和可后做内容。
quickReference.exampleEn: Which fields are essential for the first version?
quickReference.exampleZh: 第一版必须包含哪些字段？

quickReference.note: 范围包括交付内容与边界，新增请求需重新评估。
quickReference.exampleEn: The export feature is outside the current scope.
quickReference.exampleZh: 导出功能不在当前约定范围内。

quickReference.note: impact on ... 表示对时间或费用的影响；查证后再确认数字。
quickReference.exampleEn: We can review the impact on the timeline and cost.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我们可以评估对时间和费用的影响。

quickReference.note: 音标按名词 estimate，估算与确定承诺不同。
quickReference.exampleEn: If we add this, we will need to revise the estimate.
quickReference.exampleZh: 如果加入这一项，我们需要更新估算。

quickReference.note: 批准更新后的范围是开始条件，不把收到消息当作已经批准。
quickReference.exampleEn: We will start once the revised scope is approved.
quickReference.exampleZh: 更新后的范围获确认后，我们再开始。

chapters.title: 演示产品与回答问题
chapters.task: 介绍步骤 · 确认理解 · 查证未知
chapters.example: Let me walk you through the main steps.
chapters.translation: 我来带你看一下主要步骤。
chapters.scenario: 你演示一款虚构的报表工具，先说明今天展示的流程，再展示筛选与保存视图。对方询问尚未核实的导出数量上限时，明确查证并约定回复时间；演示出现网络问题时切换准备好的截图。
phrases: walk someone through 带人逐步了解
a sample report 示例报表
save a view 保存视图
a technical limit 技术限制
check with the team 向团队核实
follow up with details 补充回复详情

lines.en: Let me walk you through the main steps.
lines.zh: 我来带你看一下主要步骤。
lines.note: walk you through 指逐步讲解或演示，不是让对方自己阅读长篇说明。

lines.en: I will start with a sample report.
lines.zh: 我先从一份示例报表开始。

lines.en: First, choose the region and the date range.
lines.zh: 首先选择区域和日期范围。

lines.en: Then click Apply to update the results.
lines.zh: 然后点击 Apply 更新结果。

lines.en: You can save this view for next time.
lines.zh: 你可以保存这个视图，下次再用。

lines.en: Is that the workflow you had in mind?
lines.zh: 这是你设想的操作流程吗？

lines.en: Would you like me to show that step again?
lines.zh: 要我再展示一下那一步吗？

lines.en: What would you like to focus on next?
lines.zh: 接下来你想重点看什么？

lines.en: I do not have a confirmed answer to that yet.
lines.zh: 这个问题我暂时没有核实过的答案。
lines.note: 区分不知道与功能不支持；未查证前不把猜测当作产品能力。

lines.en: Let me check with the team and get back to you.
lines.zh: 我向团队核实后再回复你。

lines.en: I will follow up with the details by tomorrow afternoon.
lines.zh: 我会在明天下午之前补充回复详情。

lines.en: The live demo is not loading. I will use the screenshots to explain the flow.
lines.zh: 实时演示加载不出来，我会用截图说明流程。
lines.note: 截图只展示已准备的示例，不代表实时功能已经恢复；继续确认对方的问题。

dialogues.title: 演示主要流程
dialogues.subtitle: 用小步骤展示，邀请对方确认

lines.en: Let me walk you through the main steps. I will start with a sample report.
lines.zh: 我来带你看主要步骤，先从示例报表开始。

lines.en: Great. We mainly need to compare two regions.
lines.zh: 好，我们主要需要比较两个区域。

lines.en: First, choose the regions and the date range. Then click Apply to update the results.
lines.zh: 先选区域和日期范围，再点击 Apply 更新结果。

lines.en: Can I use the same settings next week?
lines.zh: 下周能用同样的设置吗？

lines.en: Yes. You can save this view for next time. Let me show you the Save view button.
lines.zh: 可以，能保存视图供下次使用，我展示一下 Save view 按钮。

lines.en: That would help us avoid selecting the filters again.
lines.zh: 这样我们就不用重新选筛选项了。

lines.en: Exactly. Is that the workflow you had in mind?
lines.zh: 正是如此，这是你设想的流程吗？

lines.en: Yes. Could we look at exporting the results next?
lines.zh: 是的，接下来能看导出结果吗？

dialogues.title: 回答尚未核实的问题
dialogues.subtitle: 记录问题并给出查证安排

lines.en: How many rows can we export at once?
lines.zh: 一次最多能导出多少行？

lines.en: I do not have a confirmed answer to that yet. About how many rows do you expect?
lines.zh: 我暂时没有核实过的答案，你们预计需要多少行？

lines.en: Around fifty thousand for a monthly report.
lines.zh: 月报大约五万行。

lines.en: Let me check with the team whether that volume is supported and what limits apply.
lines.zh: 我会向团队核实是否支持这个数量，以及适用限制。

lines.en: When could you let us know?
lines.zh: 什么时候能告诉我们？

lines.en: I will follow up with the details by tomorrow afternoon.
lines.zh: 我会在明天下午之前补充回复详情。

branches.title: 对方没有跟上
branches.subtitle: 重新展示具体一步

lines.en: I missed how you saved the view.
lines.zh: 我没看清刚才怎么保存视图。

lines.en: Would you like me to show that step again?
lines.zh: 要我再展示那一步吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Especially where the name is entered.
lines.zh: 要，谢谢，尤其是在哪里输入名称。

lines.en: Click Save view, enter the name in this field, then confirm. I will do it slowly.
lines.zh: 点击 Save view，在这个框里输入名称，再确认，我慢一点操作。

branches.title: 现场演示加载失败
branches.subtitle: 说明状态，用已有素材继续解释

lines.en: The live demo is not loading. I will use the screenshots to explain the flow.
lines.zh: 实时演示加载不出来，我会用截图说明流程。

lines.en: Will we still be able to see the export steps?
lines.zh: 我们还能看到导出步骤吗？

lines.en: Yes, in the screenshots. I will also arrange a live follow-up once the issue is resolved.
lines.zh: 可以在截图里看，问题解决后我还会安排实时补充演示。

lines.en: That works. Please include our question about the row limit in the follow-up.
lines.zh: 可以，后续请也回复我们关于行数上限的问题。

substitutions: 把 sample report 换成 sample order，介绍示例订单。
把 region and date range 换成 status and date range，展示另一组筛选。
把 tomorrow afternoon 换成 Friday morning，说明实际能做到的回复时间。
responses: I missed that step.
询问哪部分需要再展示。
Of course. Which part would you like me to show again?
Can it handle fifty thousand rows?
说明尚未核实并安排查证。
I do not have a confirmed answer yet. Let me check with the team.
The demo is not loading.
说明改用截图并安排后续。
I will use the screenshots now and arrange a live follow-up once the issue is resolved.
practice.task: 用四步演示一个熟悉的流程，每两步确认对方是否跟上；记录一个未知问题和回复时间，模拟演示失败后的替代安排。

quickReference.note: 边展示边解释，不是一次讲完所有功能。
quickReference.exampleEn: Let me walk you through the main steps.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我来带你看一下主要步骤。

quickReference.note: 示例数据不代表对方真实数据或现场测试结果。
quickReference.exampleEn: I will start with a sample report.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我先从一份示例报表开始。

quickReference.note: 说清起止日期及筛选条件，再更新结果。
quickReference.exampleEn: First, choose the region and the date range.
quickReference.exampleZh: 首先选择区域和日期范围。

quickReference.note: 检查流程是否符合对方任务，而不只问看起来好不好。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is that the workflow you had in mind?
quickReference.exampleZh: 这是你设想的操作流程吗？

quickReference.note: 未核实应说清并安排查证，不把猜测当作产品能力。
quickReference.exampleEn: I do not have a confirmed answer to that yet.
quickReference.exampleZh: 这个问题我暂时没有核实过的答案。

quickReference.note: 给出实际能做到的时间，并记录待确认问题。
quickReference.exampleEn: I will follow up with the details by tomorrow afternoon.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我会在明天下午之前补充回复详情。

chapters.title: 面试与介绍工作经历
chapters.task: 说明职责 · 举例成果 · 了解岗位
chapters.example: I was responsible for coordinating the project timeline.
chapters.translation: 我负责协调项目时间安排。
chapters.scenario: 你应聘项目协调岗位，用虚构的三个月客户上线项目说明职责、困难、行动和结果。随后询问团队协作与前三个月目标；实际面试只使用自己真实经历，区分本人贡献与团队成果。
phrases: be responsible for 负责
a project timeline 项目时间安排
coordinate with a team 与团队协调
a measurable result 可衡量结果
a learning opportunity 学习机会
the next stage 下一阶段

lines.en: I was responsible for coordinating the project timeline.
lines.zh: 我负责协调项目时间安排。
lines.note: 负责什么要具体说明；团队做出的结果不能全部归为个人完成。

lines.en: I worked closely with the support and engineering teams.
lines.zh: 我与支持团队和工程团队密切协作。

lines.en: Let me give you a specific example.
lines.zh: 我举一个具体例子。

lines.en: The main challenge was getting updates from several teams.
lines.zh: 主要难点是收集多个团队的进度更新。

lines.en: I introduced a shared checklist and a short weekly check-in.
lines.zh: 我引入了共享清单和每周简短同步。

lines.en: That helped us identify delays earlier.
lines.zh: 这帮助我们更早发现延期。

lines.en: The team completed the rollout within the agreed period.
lines.zh: 团队在约定时间内完成了上线。

lines.en: I would do one thing differently next time.
lines.zh: 下次有一件事我会换一种做法。

lines.en: I have not used that tool yet, but I have worked with similar systems.
lines.zh: 我还没用过那个工具，但用过类似系统。
lines.note: 没有用过时如实说；类似经验可以说明学习基础，不等于已经熟练。

lines.en: What would success look like in the first three months?
lines.zh: 前三个月做到什么算表现成功？

lines.en: How does this role work with the rest of the team?
lines.zh: 这个岗位怎样与团队其他成员协作？

lines.en: What are the next steps in the interview process?
lines.zh: 面试流程接下来有哪些步骤？
lines.note: 询问流程和预计时间，不默认现场会获得录用决定。

dialogues.title: 用具体项目介绍经历
dialogues.subtitle: 说清个人行动与团队结果

lines.en: Could you tell me about a project you coordinated?
lines.zh: 能介绍一个你协调过的项目吗？

lines.en: Let me give you a specific example. I helped coordinate a three-month customer rollout.
lines.zh: 我举个例子，我协助协调过一个三个月的客户上线项目。

lines.en: What were you responsible for?
lines.zh: 你负责什么？

lines.en: I was responsible for coordinating the project timeline and collecting updates from support and engineering.
lines.zh: 我负责协调时间安排，以及收集支持和工程团队的进展。

lines.en: What was the main challenge?
lines.zh: 主要难点是什么？

lines.en: Updates arrived in different formats, so I introduced a shared checklist and a short weekly check-in.
lines.zh: 进展更新格式各异，所以我引入共享清单和每周简短同步。

lines.en: What was the result?
lines.zh: 结果如何？

lines.en: That helped us identify delays earlier, and the team completed the rollout within the agreed period.
lines.zh: 这帮助我们更早发现延期，团队在约定时间内完成上线。

dialogues.title: 了解岗位和协作方式
dialogues.subtitle: 把机会问具体，确认后续流程

lines.en: Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 你有什么想问我们的吗？

lines.en: Yes. What would success look like in the first three months?
lines.zh: 有，前三个月做到什么算表现成功？

lines.en: We would want you to learn the process and independently coordinate a small rollout.
lines.zh: 我们希望你熟悉流程，并独立协调一个小型上线项目。

lines.en: How does this role work with the rest of the team?
lines.zh: 这个岗位怎样与团队其他成员协作？

lines.en: You would work with an account manager and a technical lead.
lines.zh: 你会与客户经理和技术负责人合作。

lines.en: Thank you. What are the next steps in the interview process?
lines.zh: 谢谢，面试流程接下来有哪些步骤？

lines.en: We will review this round and contact you about a possible second interview next week.
lines.zh: 我们会评估这轮表现，下周联系你是否安排第二轮。

lines.en: Thanks for explaining the role and the process.
lines.zh: 谢谢介绍岗位和流程。

branches.title: 被问到未用过的工具
branches.subtitle: 坦诚说明，联系可迁移经验

lines.en: Have you used our project management platform?
lines.zh: 你用过我们的项目管理平台吗？

lines.en: I have not used that tool yet, but I have worked with similar systems.
lines.zh: 我还没用过那个工具，但用过类似系统。

lines.en: How would you get up to speed?
lines.zh: 你会怎样尽快熟悉？

lines.en: I would learn the main workflow, practice on a sample project and check my understanding with a colleague.
lines.zh: 我会学习主要流程，用示例项目练习，并向同事确认理解。

branches.title: 被问项目中的不足
branches.subtitle: 给出具体反思，说明下一次动作

lines.en: What would you do differently next time?
lines.zh: 下次你会做什么改变？

lines.en: I would agree on the update format before the project starts.
lines.zh: 我会在项目开始前约定更新格式。

lines.en: Why would that help?
lines.zh: 这样有什么帮助？

lines.en: It would reduce follow-up questions and make risks easier to compare across teams.
lines.zh: 这样可以减少补问，也更容易比较不同团队的风险。

substitutions: 把 project timeline 换成 customer communications，按真实职责介绍。
把 a three-month rollout 换成 a six-week pilot，说明另一种项目。
把 shared checklist 换成 weekly summary，说明自己实际采取的行动。
responses: What were you responsible for?
具体说明协调时间和收集进展。
I coordinated the timeline and collected updates from the support and engineering teams.
Have you used this tool?
没用过时说明类似经验。
I have not used it yet, but I have worked with similar systems.
Do you have any questions?
询问前三个月目标。
What would success look like in the first three months?
practice.task: 用真实经历写四句：背景、本人职责、一个具体行动、可核实结果；准备一条改进反思及两个岗位问题，不编造数字或技能。

quickReference.note: 后接名词或动词 ing；说清本人职责，区别团队贡献。
quickReference.exampleEn: I was responsible for coordinating the project timeline.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我负责协调项目时间安排。

quickReference.note: coordinate the timeline 是协调时间，具体说明与谁和如何协调。
quickReference.exampleEn: I was responsible for coordinating the project timeline.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我负责协调项目时间安排。

quickReference.note: 面试时用具体困难和对应行动说明，不只说项目很难。
quickReference.exampleEn: The main challenge was getting updates from several teams.
quickReference.exampleZh: 主要难点是收集多个团队的进度更新。

quickReference.note: 名词 rollout 一词，动词 roll out 两词；这里指客户上线项目。
quickReference.exampleEn: The team completed the rollout within the agreed period.
quickReference.exampleZh: 团队在约定时间内完成了上线。

quickReference.note: 说明学习动作，不把可学习等同于已经熟练掌握。
quickReference.exampleEn: How would you get up to speed?
quickReference.exampleZh: 你会怎样尽快熟悉？

quickReference.note: 询问流程和预计时间，不预设一定进入下一轮。
quickReference.exampleEn: What are the next steps in the interview process?
quickReference.exampleZh: 面试流程接下来有哪些步骤？

chapters.title: 反馈问题与协商解决方案
chapters.english: Reporting issues and agreeing on solutions
chapters.task: 描述影响 · 提供证据 · 商定方案与期限
chapters.example: Could we review this issue and agree on the next steps?
chapters.translation: 我们能一起核查这个问题，并商定下一步吗？
chapters.scenario: 你发现报表导出缺行，向同事说明可复现步骤、影响范围和时间需求，共同核对临时方案与正式修复；另练习服务交付不符时基于约定协商。时间与故障均为虚构练习，避免在未确认前承诺根因或修复期限。
phrases: steps to reproduce 复现步骤
the affected records 受影响记录
a temporary workaround 临时替代方案
acceptance criteria 验收标准
a target date 目标日期
escalate an issue 升级处理问题

lines.en: Could we review this issue and agree on the next steps?
lines.zh: 我们能一起核查这个问题，并商定下一步吗？
lines.note: review 先一起核查；agree on 明确后续行动，而非只要求对方“尽快处理”。

lines.en: The export is missing some records from yesterday.
lines.zh: 导出结果缺少昨天的部分记录。

lines.en: Here are the steps to reproduce the problem.
lines.zh: 这是复现问题的步骤。

lines.en: I can share a sample with sensitive data removed.
lines.zh: 我可以提供一份去除敏感数据的样例。
lines.note: 只分享排查所需且允许共享的数据；遮蔽截图不等于原文件也已去除敏感信息。

lines.en: This affects the report we need to send today.
lines.zh: 这影响了我们今天需要发送的报表。

lines.en: What do we know so far, and what still needs checking?
lines.zh: 目前已经确认什么，还有什么需要核查？

lines.en: Is there a temporary workaround we can use?
lines.zh: 有我们可以使用的临时替代方案吗？
lines.note: workaround 是绕过问题的临时办法，不意味着根因已修复；需确认限制与风险。

lines.en: Could we agree on the acceptance criteria?
lines.zh: 我们能商定验收标准吗？

lines.en: Who will be responsible for each action?
lines.zh: 每项行动由谁负责？

lines.en: Can you confirm a realistic target date?
lines.zh: 能确认一个现实可行的目标日期吗？
lines.note: target date 是目标时间，不自动等于承诺；同时确认依赖、风险和下一次进展同步。

lines.en: Please let us know if the timeline changes.
lines.zh: 如果时间安排变化，请告知我们。

lines.en: I will summarize the agreed actions in writing.
lines.zh: 我会把商定的行动整理成书面记录。

dialogues.title: 说明故障及业务影响
dialogues.subtitle: 带证据反馈，区分已知与未知

lines.en: Could we review this issue? The export is missing some records from yesterday.
lines.zh: 我们能核查这个问题吗？导出结果缺少昨天的部分记录。

lines.en: Which export did you use, and can you reproduce it?
lines.zh: 你用了哪个导出？能复现吗？

lines.en: I used the daily report export. Here are the steps to reproduce the problem.
lines.zh: 我用了日报导出，这是复现问题的步骤。

lines.en: Could you share a sample so we can compare it with the source?
lines.zh: 能提供样例，让我们和原始数据比较吗？

lines.en: I can share a sample with sensitive data removed. This affects the report due today.
lines.zh: 我可以提供去除敏感数据的样例，这影响今天到期的报表。

lines.en: We have confirmed the missing rows, but we have not confirmed the cause yet.
lines.zh: 我们确认了缺行，但还没确认原因。

lines.en: Is there a temporary workaround we can use?
lines.zh: 有我们可以使用的临时替代方案吗？

lines.en: We will check an alternative export and validate its completeness before recommending it.
lines.zh: 我们会检查另一种导出，并在建议使用前验证完整性。

dialogues.title: 协商交付与验收
dialogues.subtitle: 明确责任、标准和进度同步

lines.en: Could we agree on the acceptance criteria for the fix?
lines.zh: 我们能商定这次修复的验收标准吗？

lines.en: The export should contain all records matching the selected date and filters.
lines.zh: 导出应包含所有符合所选日期和筛选条件的记录。

lines.en: We should also compare the record count and totals with the source report.
lines.zh: 我们还应把记录数和汇总值与原始报表比较。

lines.en: Agreed. I will handle the investigation, and our tester will verify those checks.
lines.zh: 同意，我负责排查，测试人员验证这些项目。

lines.en: Can you confirm a realistic target date?
lines.zh: 能确认一个现实可行的目标日期吗？

lines.en: I need to finish the investigation first. I can give a progress update by three today.
lines.zh: 我需要先完成排查，今天三点前可以同步进展。

lines.en: That works. Please let us know if the timeline changes. I will summarize the actions in writing.
lines.zh: 可以，时间安排有变化请告知，我会把行动整理成书面记录。

lines.en: Thank you. Please include the acceptance criteria and the next update time.
lines.zh: 谢谢，请把验收标准和下次同步时间也写进去。

branches.title: 服务交付不符
branches.subtitle: 对照约定提出解决选项

lines.en: The delivered file does not include the fields we agreed on.
lines.zh: 交付的文件没有包含我们商定的字段。

lines.en: Could you point out the missing fields in the agreed specification?
lines.zh: 能在已商定的规格中指出缺少的字段吗？

lines.en: Yes. Could we review the gap and agree on a revised delivery plan?
lines.zh: 可以，我们能核对差异并商定修订的交付计划吗？

lines.en: Let us confirm the scope and available options before setting a new date.
lines.zh: 我们先确认范围和可选方案，再确定新日期。

branches.title: 迟迟没有进展
branches.subtitle: 说明影响并申请适当升级

lines.en: We have not received the agreed update, and the report is still blocked.
lines.zh: 我们还没收到约定的进展同步，报表仍无法完成。

lines.en: I am sorry. The investigation is taking longer than expected.
lines.zh: 抱歉，排查比预计花的时间更长。

lines.en: Could we involve the team lead to agree on priorities and an interim plan?
lines.zh: 我们能请团队负责人一起商定优先级和临时方案吗？

lines.en: Yes. I will bring the evidence and current findings to that discussion.
lines.zh: 可以，我会带上证据和目前发现参加讨论。

substitutions: 把 missing records 换成 incorrect totals，提供相应可复现证据。
把 today 换成 by Friday morning，说明业务期限。
把 a temporary workaround 换成 a revised delivery plan，协商不同层面的解决方案。
responses: Can you reproduce the problem?
提供复现步骤和去敏样例。
Yes. Here are the steps, and I can share a sample with sensitive data removed.
We do not know the cause yet.
询问临时方案和进展同步时间。
Is there a temporary workaround, and when can you give us an update?
How will we know the fix works?
要求按原始数据核对记录数和汇总值。
We should compare the record count and totals with the source report.
practice.task: 模拟一次问题反馈会：用现象、复现步骤和业务影响说明问题，区分已确认与待核查，商定临时方案、责任人、验收标准及下次进展时间，并复述书面行动项。

quickReference.note: issue 在这里是问题，描述现象并带可复现证据。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could we review this issue and agree on the next steps?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我们能一起核查这个问题，并商定下一步吗？

quickReference.note: 按顺序说明输入、操作、期望与实际结果，方便对方核查。
quickReference.exampleEn: Here are the steps to reproduce the problem.
quickReference.exampleZh: 这是复现问题的步骤。

quickReference.note: 只提供必要且允许共享的数据，核对文件本身已去敏。
quickReference.exampleEn: I can share a sample with sensitive data removed.
quickReference.exampleZh: 我可以提供一份去除敏感数据的样例。

quickReference.note: 临时方案需验证效果和限制，不当作根因已修复。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is there a temporary workaround we can use?
quickReference.exampleZh: 有我们可以使用的临时替代方案吗？

quickReference.note: criteria 是 criterion 的复数；明确哪些可观察结果算通过。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could we agree on the acceptance criteria?
quickReference.exampleZh: 我们能商定验收标准吗？

quickReference.note: 目标日期与已承诺期限有区别，核实依赖并约定进度同步。
quickReference.exampleEn: Can you confirm a realistic target date?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能确认一个现实可行的目标日期吗？

chapters.title: 谈工作条件与薪资待遇
chapters.task: 询问薪资结构 · 协商条件 · 核对书面 offer
chapters.example: Could you share the salary range for this role?
chapters.translation: 能介绍这个岗位的薪资范围吗？
chapters.scenario: 你拿到岗位意向，询问税前基本工资、浮动奖金、工时、工作地点和试用期条款；再依据经验协商待遇，索取书面 offer 并核对回复期限。币种、税制、合同和福利因地区及公司而异，示例数字不代表市场行情。
phrases: salary range 薪资范围
gross annual base salary 税前年基本工资
a performance bonus 绩效奖金
working hours 工作时间
a written offer 书面录用通知
a probation period 试用期

lines.en: Could you share the salary range for this role?
lines.zh: 能介绍这个岗位的薪资范围吗？
lines.note: range 是范围；先确认币种、税前税后及年薪月薪口径，再比较。

lines.en: Is that the gross annual base salary?
lines.zh: 那是税前年基本工资吗？
lines.note: gross 是税前，annual 是按年，base salary 是基本工资，不包含所有奖金福利。

lines.en: Which currency is the offer in?
lines.zh: 这份 offer 使用什么币种？

lines.en: How is the performance bonus calculated?
lines.zh: 绩效奖金怎么计算？

lines.en: Which benefits are included in the package?
lines.zh: 待遇方案包含哪些福利？

lines.en: What are the usual working hours?
lines.zh: 通常的工作时间是什么？

lines.en: How is overtime handled?
lines.zh: 加班怎么安排和处理？

lines.en: Is remote or hybrid working available?
lines.zh: 可以远程或混合办公吗？

lines.en: What are the terms of the probation period?
lines.zh: 试用期条款是什么？
lines.note: 确认期限、考核、工资和通知安排等；试用期不等于可以忽略当地劳动规则。

lines.en: Based on my experience, is there room to discuss the base salary?
lines.zh: 结合我的经验，基本工资还有协商空间吗？

lines.en: Could you send the full terms in a written offer?
lines.zh: 能把完整条款写进书面 offer 发给我吗？
lines.note: full terms 要求核对完整条款；口头讨论的条件需在正式文件中确认。

lines.en: When would you need my response?
lines.zh: 你们需要我什么时候答复？

dialogues.title: 询问薪资和工作条件
dialogues.subtitle: 统一金额口径，核实奖金与工作方式

lines.en: Could you share the salary range for this role?
lines.zh: 能介绍这个岗位的薪资范围吗？

lines.en: The range is sixty to seventy thousand pounds a year.
lines.zh: 范围是每年六万到七万英镑。

lines.en: Is that the gross annual base salary, with the bonus separate?
lines.zh: 那是税前年基本工资，奖金另外计算吗？

lines.en: Yes. The performance bonus is separate and depends on the plan conditions.
lines.zh: 是的，绩效奖金另计，取决于奖金计划条件。

lines.en: How is the bonus calculated, and which benefits are included?
lines.zh: 奖金怎么计算，包含哪些福利？

lines.en: I will send the current bonus plan and the benefits summary for you to review.
lines.zh: 我会发送当前奖金计划和福利摘要供你核对。

lines.en: What are the usual working hours, and is hybrid working available?
lines.zh: 通常工作时间是什么，可以混合办公吗？

lines.en: Let us review the team schedule and the written policy together.
lines.zh: 我们一起核对团队安排和书面政策。

dialogues.title: 基于经验协商
dialogues.subtitle: 提出依据，留出核实和回复时间

lines.en: Thank you for the offer. Based on my experience, is there room to discuss the base salary?
lines.zh: 谢谢你们的 offer，结合我的经验，基本工资还有协商空间吗？

lines.en: What figure did you have in mind?
lines.zh: 你期望什么数字？

lines.en: I was hoping for sixty-eight thousand pounds gross a year, given my experience leading similar projects.
lines.zh: 考虑到我有带领类似项目的经验，我希望税前年基本工资是六万八千英镑。

lines.en: I will review that with the hiring manager. I cannot confirm a change yet.
lines.zh: 我会与招聘经理讨论，目前还不能确认调整。

lines.en: Thank you. Could you also confirm the terms of the probation period?
lines.zh: 谢谢，能同时确认试用期条款吗？

lines.en: Yes. We will include those in the written offer.
lines.zh: 可以，我们会把它们写进书面 offer。

lines.en: When would you need my response after I receive the full terms?
lines.zh: 收到完整条款后，你们需要我什么时候答复？

lines.en: Let us agree on a response deadline once the revised offer is ready.
lines.zh: 修订后的 offer 准备好后，我们再商定回复期限。

branches.title: 基本工资无法调整
branches.subtitle: 比较福利，不自动接受替代

lines.en: We cannot increase the base salary for this role.
lines.zh: 这个岗位的基本工资无法提高。

lines.en: I understand. Is there flexibility on working arrangements or professional development support?
lines.zh: 我理解，工作安排或职业发展支持方面有调整空间吗？

lines.en: We can discuss training support, but it would need approval.
lines.zh: 我们可以讨论培训支持，不过需要审批。

lines.en: Please confirm any approved changes in writing so I can review the full package.
lines.zh: 获批的调整请书面确认，让我核对完整待遇方案。

branches.title: 需要更多时间
branches.subtitle: 明确延期请求及期望答复日期

lines.en: Could you respond by tomorrow?
lines.zh: 能明天前答复吗？

lines.en: I need a little more time to review the full terms. Could I respond by Friday?
lines.zh: 我需要多一点时间核对完整条款，能周五前答复吗？

lines.en: Let me check whether we can extend the deadline.
lines.zh: 我核实一下能否延长截止时间。

lines.en: Thank you. Please let me know the confirmed date.
lines.zh: 谢谢，请告知确认后的日期。

substitutions: 把 gross annual base salary 换成 gross monthly base salary，注意同步换算金额口径。
把 hybrid working 换成 flexible starting hours，询问弹性上班时间。
把 leading similar projects 换成与你真实经历相符的理由，不编造经验。
responses: The offer is sixty-five thousand a year.
确认币种、税前基本工资与奖金口径。
Which currency is that in, and is it the gross annual base salary with the bonus separate?
What salary did you have in mind?
提出示例期望并说明经验依据。
I was hoping for sixty-eight thousand pounds gross a year, given my experience leading similar projects.
Can you accept by tomorrow?
请求周五前回复，等待确认。
Could I respond by Friday? I need time to review the full terms.
practice.task: 模拟 offer 沟通：确认币种、税前工资周期、基本与浮动部分、工时、工作方式及试用期；用真实经验提出协商，核对书面条款和回复期限后再决定。

quickReference.note: 比较前统一币种、工资周期、税前税后和基本工资口径。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you share the salary range for this role?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能介绍这个岗位的薪资范围吗？

quickReference.note: gross 税前；net 税后；base salary 不包含全部浮动奖金。
quickReference.exampleEn: Is that the gross annual base salary?
quickReference.exampleZh: 那是税前年基本工资吗？

quickReference.note: 奖金的计算、资格和支付条件需核实，不当作无条件固定收入。
quickReference.exampleEn: How is the performance bonus calculated?
quickReference.exampleZh: 绩效奖金怎么计算？

quickReference.note: 分别问清总工时、上班时段和加班安排，别只根据职位名称推断。
quickReference.exampleEn: What are the usual working hours?
quickReference.exampleZh: 通常的工作时间是什么？

quickReference.note: 确认期限、考核、工资和通知安排，并核对当地适用规则。
quickReference.exampleEn: What are the terms of the probation period?
quickReference.exampleZh: 试用期条款是什么？

quickReference.note: 确认口头商定条件进入书面文件，并核实回复期限。
quickReference.exampleEn: Could you send the full terms in a written offer?
quickReference.exampleZh: 能把完整条款写进书面 offer 发给我吗？
